༄༅// bsngags 'os dam pa rnams la legs dbul stob pa'i gong brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnam par dpyod ldan kun dga'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rin chen dbang gi rgyal// dge legs mtshan bzang lham mer snang ba bskal pa'i bar// mi 'gyur rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo nas// bkra shis 'dod dgu'i char du che gang rgyal gyur cig /thub dbang ye shes 'od snang dag pa'i smyig gu yis// bdag dang bzhed gcig smra ba'i dbang por lung bstan gyi// 'phrin yig bkrag cher bris ltar rnam 'dren bstan pa la// mkhas pa'i las byas kun gyi rgyal po kun dga' bzang*// zla bral mkhas tshul gsum gyis de tshul dri ma med// srid gsum sgrib pa'i mun pa za phyir glal ba'i lce// 'og min bar du ring por brkyangs pa'i cho ga mkhan// gdan gsum lha yi 'khor los spyi bor dbang bskur ba// rin chen gsum tshogs 'dus pa gang gi rnam par thar// rjod byed yi ge'i lam du 'dzad par mi 'gyur bar// gdengs can rgyal po'i grong khyer nyin mtshan bar ma chad// dag byed 'bab pas gzhar yang 'dzad pa med pas mtshon// mkhas btsun bzang por grub pa'i yon tan phung po'i mtha'// yong ye 'tshol 'dod bdag gi blo gros skad cig ma'i// brdzur zhugs lan gcig min par btsal bas ma rnyed pa'i// ngo tshas lus skyes gzings pa'i lkog tu yib bam snyam// srid par bsngags brjod yul du gyur pa mang mchis kyang*// sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje slob dpon 'dra ba su// mkha' dbyings bkrag cher shar ba mi ltung phreng ba'i khrod// ku mud bzhad pa'i rtsa lag gnyis pa cang srid dam// smra ba mkhas pa stong gi sgra don rgyan gyi glu// skye bar blangs kyang che ba'i gu ṇa phyogs re'i mthar// bgrod par ma bzod rnam par dub pa'i yan lag lnga// ngal gsor spyod snyam bgyid pa'i zhabs stegs ga la bar// bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa yan lag mchog thob las// nyer 'khrungs rab dga'i na tshod gzhon nu 'di 'dra ni// mgon khyod byams chen rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma shar bar// de srid brtan par bzhugs las thob kyi gzhan du ci// bsod nams byed pos nyer bskrun pad+ma'i rdzing bu las// zang zing 'byor ba'i 'dab stong dgod pa btus pa'i phreng*// dga' ston tshul du gtor ba 'di ko byang chub bar// 'dzad med mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung por gnas gyur cig

/'dir 'bad dge bas skye ba 'di dang yang 'byung bcas// rgyal kun 'dus zhal dpal ldan bla ma mnyes bgyid cing*// gtsug lag chos kyi dpal 'byor ma tshang med bzung nas// khams gsum 'gro la chos kyi dga' ston bkye phyir bsngo// bkra shis pa'i lha dang dkar pos mtshon pa'i rnam grangs bcu bdun 'di zhu dag bla mas gus par phul ba lags/ mkhan po rin po che rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan par rang gis khri 'bul legs mtshon stob pa'i gong brjod du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen rang gis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// phyogs bcu'i rnam par 'dren kun gyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sa bon stobs// yongs rdzogs dge legs kun gyi gter// skyabs mchog dpag bsam dbang po rgyal// tshogs zung lhun po'i phrag las thon// rgyal bstan kun gsal mdzes pa'i rgyan// mkhas tshul gsum gyi gzi stong gis// srid pa'i mun 'phrog nyin mor byed// khyod zhabs shis pa'i mtshan ris can// 'khor ba mtha' can gyur gyi bar// skye dgu'i bla mar brtan byed pa'i// bsnyengs bral seng ge'i khri drung du// dad dga' brtas pa'i thal sbyar gyis// nye bar btud pa'i bka' 'bangs dag /dbang gi rgyal po gtsug thob las// lhag pa'i spro bas 'di skad gsol// brgya phrag dka' ba spyad pa med// zong gi dngos brgyas bsgrubs min par// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i 'dren pa mchog /dngos mjal skal ba'i snod dag yangs// gcig tu bsod nams shing rtar brten// bdag cag rnams kyi sdum bar du// zhabs rdul dri med kyis btab pa'i// drin mtha' nam mkhas mtshon du ci// 'on te bsags pa'i dngos phran las// snying po bla med blang phyir du// sku drin gsob pa'i maṇ+ḍal mtshon// nyung zad stobs 'dir dgyes tshul gnang*// mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa dpal bzang po pa nyid/ bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho tshe ring nor bu sku mched rnams kyis khyim phebs g.yar 'dren zhus nas legs 'bul stob pa'i gong brjod nyung ngu 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge'o//

// ༄༅// rnam 'dren rigs kyi gtso bo dga' mar bcas// snying brtse'i gter brgyad mchod 'bul sgyu rtsal spyod// bgegs dgra dpa' bo dpa' mor bcas pa'i lha// kun rdzogs 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /yid srub dpung sreg bi shwa na ra'i bu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung tshad skyob dkar po'i gdugs// 'gro tshogs srid mtsho las gdon ded dpon bzang*// kun gyi re skong yongs 'du sa brtol tshe// drang srong rig 'dzin blo ldan bye ba brgyas// bsngags brjod gling bu grangs med bsgyur bas kyang*// che ba phyogs re'i pha rol ma phyin pas// mkhas pa'i stan la ngal gsor byin nam snyam// legs byas byed po tshangs pa'i mdzub rtse yis// dge legs mtshan bzang bkra byas bgrod byed dag /'phrog byed dbang pos srid pa mtha' can zhig /ma mthong de srid brtan byed gang yin der// mtshun za 'bar ba'i lce zhags brkyangs pa'i khar// chu snod ma bzod lang ling khol ba ltar// dad gsum shugs kyis yid g.yos slob bu'i tshogs// spro ba khong nas brtas pa'i mchid bu 'bul// bslu med skyabs gsum 'dus pa gang gi zhabs// phan bde'i rdul phreng 'bum phrag 'dzag pa deng*// bdag cag rnams kyi bsti gnas nyer btab pa'i// skal ba dam pa'i sku drin gzhal phyir dang*// bro 'tshal lnga pa'i grong du bgrod nye ba// drin du che ldan tshul khrims brtan pa can// ngan song skye sgo 'gog pa'i dbang bskur drin// gtang rag maṇ+ḍal dngos 'bul 'di ltar lags// lha dar dkar po sogs bri/ zhes rgya dpon o rgyan don grub pa sku mched rnams kyis/ mkhan po chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid/ sdum par du spyan 'dren zhus shing*/ dge slong tshul khrims brtan pa la kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob pa'i legs 'bul gyi gong brjod du// ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//

// ༄༅// phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren sras bcas rnams// mtshan nyid kun ldan slob dpon skur// kun gyis bsti gnas rnam brtags nas// cig car tshogs pa'i 'dren mchog rgyal// tshur mthong blo ngor mkhas btsun dang*// bzang po'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i// chos smra mchog gi sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba byang chub 'khrid brtson pa// zla bral mkhyen brtse'i khyung sngon skyes// gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung lugs nyi// thub dbang chos mkhar 'dren bgyid pas// sgrib pa'i thun gsum mun pa bcom// shes bya'i gnas tshul nyin mo yi// ngo mtshar snang ba'i ltad mo dag /dpyod ldan 'dren byed yul ngom pa'i// mkhas tshul smra ba'i mchog gcig khums// gang sku gzhom bral zho 'thung bu'i// rus pa las skyes rtse brgya ltar// srid pa'i pha mtha' ma mthong ba// de srid brling byed chos kyi khrir// kun bzang bstan pa'i rjes zhugs kyang*// de spyod rjes su blang dor gyi// gom pa bkod pa ma bzod pa'i// bka' 'bangs tha chungs des gsol pa// deng dus rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gang*/ chos ldan sa skyong chen po'i sku drin la brten/ bod chen ljongs kyi skye 'gro'i skyabs su thob/ khyad par da lam mong rtul bdag gi grwa khang du zhabs kyi 'khor los bcags pa'i rdul phran pad+ma rā ga'i thigs pas bran pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi brgya 'bar bar byin gyis brlabs/ kho bor re ltos gang yod kyi drin can snga lam du song ba rnams byang chog gi rjes 'dzin gnang ba bcas/ gang ci'i sku drin gsob mtshon maṇ+ḍal brda mtshon tsam du lha dar gyis mtshon pa'i 'bul tshan 'di dag par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin gyis phul/ zhes pa'i gleng ba nyung ngu 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// rab 'byams zhing gi rnam par 'dren kun gyi// mkhyen brtse nus rtsal rdzogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// rigs gsum gdul bya byang chub la 'god pa'i// smra dbang chos kyi rgyal po rgyal gyur cig

/shes bya'i mtshan nyid kun gzigs mkhas pa'i mchog /nyes med bslab pas legs sdom btsun pa'i phul// byang chub sems 'byongs 'gro ba'i mdza' bshes bzang*// theg gsum bstan pa'i rgyan gyur khyod gcig khums// bsod nams pir gyis legs bris dge mtshan zhabs// lhar bcas skye dgu'i spyi bor bskal pa brgyar// brtan byed cho ga tshe mtha' yas pa sogs// rgyal kun mgrin gcig sgrub pa ga la bar// yid gcugs dang bral srid pa'i snang tshul can// yong ye skyo sems mdongs mtha' gzhon nu des// skyabs gcig mchog gi thugs rje'i sprin rum der// dad gus 'dren byed nyer gtod 'di skad gsol// 'di na sa skyong mched zlas sbrel legs gang*// bar chad zhags mig chud par rkyen sel gyi// ral gri stong gis mi chod 'ching thag de// las kyi byed po min pa su yis bskrun// sngon las btsan pos btab pa'i dus mtshams de// bskal nus 'ga' yang med pa rgyu 'bras gshis// 'bras ldan dus kyi rgyal mo'i rjes nyid nas// mi 'dod dgun gyi reg pa khad kyis 'byung*// 'on te bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa nyid// lhas bskos mgron du khugs dang lhan cig tu// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs bral dus 'das rnam par shes// bde ldan zhing sogs bgrod pa'i rdzu 'phrul stsal// de bzhin gshegs dang de sras thos sgrogs dang*// rkyen gcig rtogs dang bgegs dgra 'jig rten skyong*// kun gyi khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad dang*// dbyer med dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i skur bzhengs nas// phyir bzlog dbang bskur rnam dag cho gar brten// dus 'das kyis mtshon rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed grangs// mnyam pa'i 'gro tshogs dus 'di nyid nas bzung*// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs bral thar pa'i grong khyer bcug /'jug pa bcu pa'i bgrod byed bkrus pa med// drang srong khros pa'i kha chus ma bslad pa'i// rnam dag cho ga'i mtho ris dag byed kyis// sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas pa bcad cing sbyong*// 'phro 'du 'od kyi snang ba re res kyang*// sdug bsngal rgyur bcas sbyang ba'i rnam thar sngon// lha bu dmyal bar ltung dgu thub dbang gis// skad cig bde la sbyar rjes rkang pa 'jog

/'dzam bu rkang 'thung gis mtshan gling rdzogs pa// mdog bzang phung por bsgyur ba'i rin thang gis// zla bral sku drin che ba'i brgya stong cha'i// do zlar phod snyam mi bgyid de lta na'ang*// bsags pa'i dngos po yon tan zhing dam par// mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal sprul nas stobs pa 'dis// dmigs yul gyis mtshon lus can rgya mtsho'i rgyud// tshogs zung nor bu'i 'byor pa rgyas phyir lags// de'ang lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son/ legs bshad mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas/ smra mkhas bye ba'i bsngags 'os/ srid gsum gnas na sgrun zlas dben pa'i skyabs yul kun 'dus 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po gang de'i zhabs zung ut+pal dmar pos sgeg pa'i chos kyi rkang stegs dam pa ga la bar/ dal rten rkang 'thung ldam pa'i phang bar dad gus kyi lo 'dab rnam par dud pas gsol ba/ grangs med bskal par bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis dag byed gter chen/ rmad byung thugs bskyed smon lam gyi ri bos bsrubs pa'i snying po/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs nyin mor byed pa dge legs mtshan bzang dkyil 'khor kun nas rdzogs pa gang de/ yongs rdzogs chos kyi mkha' dkyil brtan par 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa nas/ slar yang mdo khams tha gru yangs par stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lugs bzang spyi'i sgrib pa'i mun stug bcil zhing bye brag gzhung lugs kun la chos mig dri bral brnyes pa'i yongs rtse/ tshad med pa'i thugs rjer ldan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mtshungs med brtse chen snying po'i zhabs dang*/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po zung gis legs par bzhag pa'i lugs mchog sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan can gyi dga' tshal phyogs bral du rgyas pa'i khrod dag tu/ de 'dzin thub pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i smra mkhas rkang pa drug ldan gyi 'dus tshogs bgrang las 'das pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba dag gis/

bshad sgrub snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'og min bar du lud pa bsgrag pa'i phyir dang*/ bstan pa dam pa'i rjes su rkang pa bkod pa bdag cag ltos dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyi'ang bla med byang chub snying po'i bar du bgrod par byed pa'i rnam grol thar pa'i lam chen yan lag dang bcas pa'i snang byed gcig pur gtsug gi rgyan mchog tu mnga' gsol ba'i phyir/ lhag bsam dge ba'i gsol 'debs khyung sngon skyes kyi kha lo bsgyur ba gang des/ legs byas yangs pa'i kun gsal lus phra'i mkhur tshos spa ba'i rgyan du legs par khugs pa'i legs gsol dga' ston du bcas pa dag sa skyong gcen po yab sras lha lcam bcas nas mi 'gyang bar 'bul dgos pa som nyi ci la srid rung*/ blo gros dkyil che ba'i sa skyong rigs kyi gcen de nyid/ de skabs nas don snod la mi bde ba'i snyung gzhi ha cang zug po min pa zhig gis gzhi chen bcas yod par/ re zhig bro 'tshal yar bde nam byung zhig gi bar bsrings nas/ mi ring bar mkhan chen thugs rje'i gter chen nyid/ bdag cag rnams kyi skye yul bsti gnas su bcas par byas pa'i sa phyogs 'dir spyan 'dren zhus nas/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs kyis bcags pa'i byin rlabs kyi 'od rdul btab pas/ sa gzhi thams cad mchod rten lta bur bskrun 'dod dang*/ rang re mchod yon tshang ma thabs gcig tu zhal 'dzom gyi thog nas/ dga' ston ro bda'i dpal la rtsen zhing*/ bzod pa dam pas lan brgyar phyis pa snyam bgyid pa'i mthong don che ba'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal zhing*/ legs 'bul swasti sgra dbyangs snyan po srid rtse'i bar du snyan par bsgyur ba dang chabs cig lhag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor chen po gang yang rung ba zhig tu smin byed kyi dbang bskur nod pa dang*/ rten gsum pho brang bcas pa la rab tu gnas pa'i me tog gi sil mas 'thor ba'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar bskrun 'dod kyi 'dun par/

ri dwags skom pas chab gtsang gi btung bar sred pa bzlog par dka' ba lta bur yod pa'i 'phro la/ snyung gzhi'i babs ji ljir song bas bsam don chu shing bzhin du snying pos dben par gyur pa de lta na'ang*/ brtse gcugs sku tshe'i dus 'das de nyid kyi bzhed pa gang yod ltar dang*/ sa dbang gi rigs sras lha lcam du bcas pa'i bzhed don gang yod ltar legs 'bul rnams dpang mthor stob thub pa byung na/ ji skad du/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba ltar tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs gcig mchog la phul bas/ snying pos dben pa'i zang zing las mchog gi snying po blangs par 'gro bas/ gson gshin kun gyi rgyud la tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong de las che ba sgrub thabs med pa gor ma chag mod/ da lam glo bur du yon gnas kyi yul dam pa yon mchod du 'brel lo cog la bsngo rten dang*/ 'don brjod rnam dkar dge brdzang gi gtong sgor 'gro che ba'i rgyus bsam tshod tsam stob par ma spobs na'ang*/ mi dman lhag bsam gyi byed pos/ bsod nams bgo skal dang 'tsham pa'i bang mdzod rnam par phye ba las brnab sems kyi srad bus bcings pa med pa'i sug pas nye bar blangs pa'i dngos rdzas nyung shas shig dad sgrol mchog gi gsang gsum mi 'gyur bskal pa'i dkyus su rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brtan byed chos grwa chen po dpal lhun grub steng zhes grags pa'i zla snang ring du song ba'i chos kyi khri ga la bar mnga' gsol ba'i legs so'i gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i mtshon byed dang*/ thab gsos kyi brdar 'dogs bcas la kha dar dkar po sogs bcas pa'i tshan grangs 'di dag sa skyong gi rigs skyes khu tsha lha lcam zung du bcas pa lhan cig pas gus pas phul ba lags so// zhes khyu mchog gi gnam lo tshes par sde dge sa skyong bsod nams mgon po pa sku tshe'i dus las bskal pa na/

ngor mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa shar pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs nyid bkra shis ltem gyi rgyal khab tu spyan 'dren zhus nas/ 'da' ka'i gdams ngag zab mo 'bogs pa nas brtsams te/ dgung bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du bzhugs nas/ dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i phyir bzlog dbang bskur gyi rim pa dang sku gdung zhugs 'bul/ sāts+tsha'i cho gar bcas pa'i rjes 'dzin legs par stsal ba'i gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang zab gsos stob pa lhan cig pa'i dus kyi 'bul yig rab 'byams mchod yul dgyes pa'i sprin gyi bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong khri chen bla ma chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa'i bka' lung gser gyi cod paṇa spyi bor bcings 'phral/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dpal 'byor gling gi rgyal khab tu bris pa shu bha mastu sarba dza gā taṃ// // ༄༅// oṃ swasti bi dza ya tu/ tshad med yon tan gom pa bgrod tsam gyis// rdo rje'i sa mchog gnon pa'i mthu rdzogs kyang*// mtha' yas gdul bya byang chub smin bya'i phyir// mchog gi slob dpon rnam rol rgyal gyur cig /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i go 'phang dpal// ci 'dod 'jo de dpag bsam rkang 'thung min// skyabs kun 'dus zhal dpal ldan bla ma yi// thugs rje phyogs bral rgyas pa'i yongs 'du nyid// khyod kyi zhabs stegs legs bris mi bdag dang*// gdengs can dbang sogs khengs ldan yongs btud pa'i// lung rtogs chos kyis mngon par mthor bgyis pa'i// bsnyengs bral gdong lngas bsgyings ba gang yin der// rnam dkar dpyid kyi rgyal mos mgron gnyer ba'i// dal rten chu skyes gzhon nu 'khor ba'i mtha'// rnam bzhis skyo ba'i yid kyi ge sar rtser// zhu chung bung ba'i sbyug glu 'di skad gsol// deng 'dir sa skyong rigs kyi brtse gcugs de// 'tsho thabs cho ga kun gyis ma bzlog par// dbang med dus 'dzin dregs pa'i khang stong bar// bzod dka'i sdug bsngal 'di dag las kyis sprul// 'on te dad sgrol thugs rje'i gter nyid nas// gsang chen bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye zhing*// ngan 'gro'i sgo 'gegs dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// rnam shes sangs rgyas zhing 'phos gdon mi za// dmigs yul gyis mtshon grangs med 'gro ba cog

/ngan 'gro las bsgral bde chen thar pa'i sar// 'khrid byed snying rje'i phyag rgya ring brkyangs nas// ngan 'gro srid pa'i gdung skyob stsal ba'i drin// rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar gal te gzhal bya ru// song ba gang tshe do zla ma ldang gi /dogs pas stong gsum chen po'i snod bcud kyi// dngos ni tshangs pas ched du sprul lam snyam// de lta na yang lhag bsam byed po yis// bsags pa'i dngos po dge ba'i tshong zong du// mngon par sprul nas tshogs gnyis rin thang tshad// gzhal bar dka' ba'i nor bu rin chen bsgrubs// 'khor ba'i dngos 'byor yon tan zhing phul nas// dpag yas bsod nams tshogs mang bsgrubs pa 'dis// gser 'gyur rtsir brten dngos rdzas phal pa yang*// mdog bzang phung por bsgyur ba gyi nar byas// tshul 'di sku tshe'i dus 'das mi bdag gi /nyer mtshon khams gsum skye 'gro kun gyi rgyud// mthar thug bsod nams brgya pa'i gzugs kyi sku// gegs med 'grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di ltar lags// de'ang shes bya kun gyi de kho na nyid legs par mkhyen cing legs par smra ba la bsnyengs pa bral ba'i mkhas dbang dam pa/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyis legs par bcas pa'i chos 'dul bslab gzhi phra rags tshul bzhin du bsrung zhing gzhan dag la legs par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i myu gu rnams kyis bslab bya rmad byung spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin nas/ 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i mdza' bshes dam pa/ tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po mchog gi go 'phang du bgrod pa'i nye lam rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa mtha' dag bzung nas/ lus can rgya mtsho'i rgyud du zung 'jug sku bzhi'i lam dang 'bras bu ci rigs pa sbyor ba'i dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' nyid nas/ deng dus bdag cag gi mched zlar gyur pa'i sa skyong blo gros mdzangs ldan bstan jus kyi bgyi bar dpyod pa'i blo ldan rten gling lta bur gyur pa de nyid bro 'tshal gyis gtses pa'i tshe'ang rkyen sel dbang bskur gyi rim pa dang*/

bsod nams kyi thag pa phra mos ma zin pa ltar dus kyi chos klong du yol bar gyur pa'i gnas skabs 'dir yang ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i duḥkha myong 'gyur gyi las sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong byed gsang chen rgyud sdes bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang bskur byin rlabs thabs lam zab mo'i gdams pa 'bogs pa la sogs pa'i sman 'dogs thugs brtses bskyangs pa sogs/ mdor na ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las bsgral te gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan bde bla na ma mchis pa la sbyor bar mdzad pa'i sku drin gyi cha shas gsob mtshon du lha dar dkar po sogs 'bul tshan 'di dag phul ba lags so// zhes khyu mchog gi bgrang gzhir sa skyong bsod nams mgon po pa bro 'tshal gyis sku la nye zhos bslad pa na/ gnas lnga rig pa smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po/ si tu sprul pa'i sku bstan pa'i nyin byed pa spyan 'dren zhus nas/ bro 'joms rkyen sel bsgrubs pa nas brtsams dus 'das skabs kyi gdams ngag gi mtshams sbyor dang dgung bdun phrag bdun gyi bar bzhugs nas/ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas 'khor ba dang ngan 'gro'i sgrib sbyong gi cho ga dang*/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul bcas pa'i rjes 'dzin bka' drin stsal ba'i gtang rag gi mdun 'jog stob pa'i 'bul yig rnam par dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong khri chen bla ma chen po blo gros rgya mtsho ba'i bka' stsal spyi bor phebs 'phral/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ dpal 'byor gling gi rgyal khab tu sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// dge mtshan mi 'gyur phreng ba'i rkang rtse yis// reg pas phan bde'i mya ngan med pa'i kha// dge spyod 'bum phrag bye ba dkon mchog gsum// dge ba'i bshes tshul bla ma rgyal gyur cig

/phyogs bcu'i rnam par 'dren kun ye shes khams// skal mnyam srid pa'i yol gor 'khyil ba'i gzugs// theg gsum bstan pa 'chad rtsom brtsad gsum gyis// smra mkhas ngur smrig 'chang ba yongs kyi tog /tshogs gnyis bi shwa karmas mngon brdar ba'i// dge legs mtshan bzang gzi 'od 'bar ba gang*// lam gsum rgud pa'i mun pa dbrog phyir du// dpal stug bstan pa'i mkha' dkyil lham mer gsal// shes bya gnas lnga'i gzhung lugs snang ngo cog /'dzad med mgrin pa'i lam nas rtag 'jo ba// dzah+nu'i rgyun chen nyin mtshan bar ma chad// bskal par 'bab kyang mi zad rjes su snyegs// pha mthas dben pa'i khengs ldan ji snyed chos// skyes sbyangs rtsal gyis bskyed pa'i mkhyen klong du// bde bar chud pa'i ngo mtshar la blta ched// 'jam dpal gzhon nus lan brgyar lhag bsam bgyid// dpag yas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gu ṇi kas// lus can kun gyi gnas skabs mthar thug gi /re bskong bas 'dir snang 'dod 'byung dpyid// dpag bsam yongs 'du ngo tshas nags su bros// mkhas tshul gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas kyi// lha rdzing ring mo'i 'phrin yig snyan dgu dag /ma byin phrogs pa'i thub chod las 'di 'dras// thub dbang bcas pa'i 'gal zlar ma gyur grang*// bsngags yul mchog gi bgrod byed 'khor lo'i gzugs// bsod nams byed pos bkrag cher bkra byas pa// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i thor tshugs rtser// brtan byed chos kyi khri 'phang gang yin der// 'khor ba'i skyed tshal dal rten dbyar skyes phang*// dad gus me tog nyung ngur bkra ba las// tshogs pa sum ldan puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i tshogs// cung zad tshar du dngar ba 'di ltar lags// deng 'dir lhar bcas skye dgu'i skyabs kyi dam pa nyid/ 'dzam gling thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che spyi'i gzhal med khang par rtag par bzhugs pa nas/ sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs pa dam pas phyogs su lhung ba med par skye 'gro kun du ma khyab pa ci zhig

'on te deng dus bdag cag gi khu bo mnyes gshin brtse bas bskyangs pa'i drin chen de nyid glo bur rkyen dbang du stor ba/ dus 'das de nyid rang rgyud du dge sbyor gyi bag chags phra zhing*/ gcig tu sde dge sa skyong chen po'i jus don gyi bgyi ba kho nas kha na ma tho ba'i phung po'i khur lci bas/ skyabs yul mchog rnams thugs rje'i ram mda' sbron pa las ci bgyir ma mchis gshis/ khyad par 'di nas byang chub bar gyi legs nyes kyi blo ltos 'cha' yul rje btsun dam pa nyid las lhag pa bskal par btsal du med pa'i dang 'dod yid ches kyi sgo nas spyan 'dren zhu ham gsol ba btab par/ bshul lam bgrod pa'i ngal tshegs sogs su ma ltos par/ thugs rje'i shing rtas bskyod kyi sdum par 'dir zhabs kyis bcags thub par phebs nas/ dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyis nges par bstan pa'i sdig sbyong gi rim pa rnams legs par stsal ba'i sku drin la bsams na/ stong gsum rin po che sna bdun gyis legs par gtams nas phul bas kyang cha shas 'tshob pa ga la bzod/ de lta na'ang rang gi dbang thang gi dkyil 'khor la dpags pa'i bgo skal du thob pa nyung zad bsags pa'i dngos rdzas mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du sprul nas/ dmigs yul de nyid 'di nas byang chub bar du thugs rjes gzung bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i mtshon byed tsam du lha dar dkar pos mtshon pa'i 'bul tshan gyi dngos po 'di dag phul ba brtse dbyings nas bzhes pa gsol ba 'debs pa lags so// zhes khyu mchog gi lor 'bri chu gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram ngogs nas sde dpon a dran bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa sku tshe'i dus las 'das pa'i skabs su/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po shar pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa nyid/ chos sde'i pho brang du spyan 'dren zhus nas/ ngan 'gro sbyong ba kun rig gi byang chog bsngo ba smon lam gyis rjes bzung byung ba'i gtang rag dngos 'bul gyi gong brjod gleng ba bcas 'di'ang*/

dbon dge slong kun dga' blo gros kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig 'dir rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rgyan gyur khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i legs 'bul byed pa la/ thog mar dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang du seng ge'i khri bkod legs su bshams pa la/ bzhugs gdan rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan par 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu g.yung drung ris su bkod pa dang*/ dkon mchog gi rten dang nye logs su yan lag bdun pa'i mchod 'bul gyi nyer spyod spos mar me zhal zas kyi phreng ba ci 'byor dang*/ gzhan yang sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs ci mdzes su bya/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar byed pa'i bla ma dge slong gi dge 'dun bcas bzhugs pa'i bzhugs bral rnams bsham/ logs shig na bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i bzhugs khri bkod legs dang sku 'khor rnams kyi rnam gzhag dang mthun pa'i 'bol gdan gral gdan rnams kyang bsham/ rnam par rgyal ma sogs yi dam gyi lha gang yin gyi rjes gnang gi mchod gtor tshom bu bcas pa'ang bsham/ de nas thog mar dge 'dun rnams rnga dung gi brdas spyan drangs nas gral la bzhugs te chos spyod kyi rim pa la/ thub dbang bstod pa/ gong ma lnga bstod/ rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma'i gsol 'debs/ kun dga' bzang po'i bstod pa rab sde rba gsum grags pa tshogs 'don bya/ sde snod ma'i 'go tsam nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang spyan 'dren pa'i spos sna ba btang rgya gling gi dbyangs dang bcas pas tshogs dbur spyan 'dren zhu zhing bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol/ der bzhugs ma thag nas rjes gnang gang yin gyi mchod pa byin rlabs nas bdag mdun sgrub pa bzlas pa bcas mdzad ma zin gyi bar du tshogs pa rnams kyis gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa tshar gcig dang*/

rab dkar ma'i bstod pa tshar gsum mam bdun gang rung gi rjes ma tshar gcig la chu 'bebs kyi gdangs bya/ de mthar skye ba kun du sogs nas mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog gi bar brjod/ de mtshams nas tshogs pa thams cad bzhengs pa'i phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas te/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid sogs dang sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku bla ma'i sku ni sogs sh+lau ka gsum/ bla ma sangs rgyas sogs/ ston pa bla med sogs sh+lau ka re re dang*/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod ces pa'i bar gyis phyag bya/ me tog 'thor zhing rol mo dang bcas te/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang sogs nas phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de nas thams cad kyis pus mo g.yas pa'i sla nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o zhes pa'i bar dang*/ phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig sogs dang*/ chos rnga chen po'i sogs brjod do// de nas 'bul ba'i thog mar mi bsod nams dang ldan pa'am ming bkra legs pa zhig gis bkra shis kha dar dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba rnams re re bzhin du ser sbring gi bkod pa ltar gcig rjes gcig gis zin bzhin du bteg 'ongs pa rnams zhal ta ba gral bsgrigs pa mkhas pa'i ngag bkod bzhin du legs par bsgrigs te bsham tshar ba dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sku 'khor du bcas pa'ang gdan la bzhugs tshar ba dang slob dpon du 'os pa zhig gis/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi dngos po rnams la bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bskal par brtan pa rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las dang 'gro don thams cad phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/

bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sku tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bskal par brtan pa dang*/ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las dang 'gro don thams cad phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig thams cad kyis gdangs dang bcas te me long ye shes rgya mtsho zhes pa lta bu'i rigs 'gre'o// de nas 'bul yig gi tho rnams bsgrags/ de rjes maṇ+ḍal thogs pa'i dge slong zhig gis maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba bskul ba la/ deng 'dir lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs kyi dam pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa'i snang byed kyi skyes bu chen po/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa mtha' dag 'dzin cing legs par smra ba la 'gran zlas dben pa'i 'phags pa dgra bcom pa chen po/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor gyis 'khor los srid gsum thams cad dbang bsgyur zhing sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snang srid kyi dngos po thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i 'khor los yang dag par gzigs shing gsang chen rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho'i bstan pa ma lus pa legs par 'doms pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/ bod chen por grags pa'i ljongs kyis mtshon pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi snang ba chen po 'gyed pa'i phyir dang*/

sems can rgya mtsho'i rgyud du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon rma med pa 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sku mched khu dbon sku 'khor du bcas pas 'di nas bla na med pa'i byang chub snying po la thug gi bar gyi bla'i cod paṇa du mnga' gsol phyir spyan 'dren gyi gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i ngor/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i snying stobs kyi rnam par thar pa'i khur khyer bas/ ljongs 'dir gegs bral du phebs thub pa'i dga' ston gtang rag dang*/ phebs nas kyang sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bskal pa ji srid pa de srid du brtan par bzhugs pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i mtshon byed du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ste/ de'i rnam gzhag spro na rgyas bsdus bar ma gang rigs kyi bshad pa byed pa zhig byung na shin tu legs par 'gyur bar sems so// gang ltar yang maṇ+ḍal brda sprod rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig gis sngun bsu nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu sum cu so bdun pa 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod/ dbu mdzad pas dal zhing dod par bskul te/ thams cad kyi mgrin bsgrigs la 'don/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba spos rengs kyis brda sprod pa'i tshul dang bcas te bteg mjug tu ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dang maṇ+ḍal mdun skyags kyi khar 'bul/ slar yang gong gi mchod rdzas dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs nas/ maṇ+ḍal la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig sogs dang*/ chos rnga chen po sogs dang*/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i sogs brjod do// skabs 'dir rje btsun chen po nas/

bstan pa rgyas pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bsngo ba mdzad byung ba na thams cad kyis de'i mthun gyur legs par bya/ de nas mdun 'jog gi dngos po rnams bsdus te logs shig tu spungs te bzhag las kyi rdo rje zhig gis rjes gnang gi gral du gang yod la me tog bkye bsdu byas te gral la bsgrigs te 'khod du gzhug rje btsun chen pos rjes gnang mdzad tshar du nye ba na gzhan zhig gis bkra shis kyi 'thor nas bkye zhing rjes/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid ces sogs nas/ srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog ces pa'i rjes su dbu mdzad pas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas bskul te/ thams cad kyis bkra shis rgyas pa zhig brjod la/ 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa rnams bya'o// zhes e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs so drug pa mkhan po chen po shar chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal sngar sde dge bla ma chen po blo gros rgya mtsho pa'i bsod nams gzhal du med pa'i shing rtas/ mdo khams ljongs kyi skye 'gro spyi'i legs byas kyi mgron du spyan drangs nas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i rnam gnon gyi lo'i rgyu skar gyi lha mo mgos nya yongs su gang ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i 'phrod chen dpal gyi be'ur 'dzom pa'i nyin/ dpal lhun grub steng gi dge 'dun 'du ba'i dri'i gtsang khang chen po bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i dbus su chos kyi khri ga la bar mnga' gsol te/ khri 'bul chen po stob pa'i dus kyi nyer bsdogs go rim ji ltar 'os pa yi ger bris shig ces pa'i bka' lung phebs 'phral du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis ljongs 'dir sngar srol ji ltar byung ba dang grwa sa chen po'i lugs srol la dpags te nyer bsdogs kyi grabs bsgrigs su bris pa bkra shis rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/
