la bar// dad gsum blo yi phreng rgyud mkhan ma des// rig gzhung pad+ma'i rdzing nas nyer btus pa'i// zhu tshig puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i chun 'phyang 'di// gdong lngas mtshan pa'i rkang stegs mdzes phyir brgyan// srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// skyabs yul zla bral yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// lhag pa'i lha mchog rigs brgya'i thor tshugs rtser// ngal gsor spyod pa'i gzi byin brgya phrag 'bar// gang tshe mkhas tshul dri med gsum sgo nas// theg gsum bstan pa spyi dang khyad par can// tshe gcig 'pho bral rdo rje'i sar sbyor ba'i// gsang chen theg pa'i sgo mang 'byed mkhas pas// phyogs bral gdul bya thabs dang 'bras bu'i rgyud// sbyor ba'i phrin las 'bad med lu gu rgyud// phyogs nas phyogs dang kho ra khor yug tu// bskal par 'tsho gzhes bskrun pa'i sman pa mchog /gang gi gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gtam// mi 'gyur phreng du dngar la ma drug skyes// mdzub rtse'i zlos gar bskal par bsgyur bas kyang*// pha rol ma phyin legs bris khrod du ngal// 'dab bzang dbang po yongs 'dus rtser 'dzegs kyang*// res 'ga' dug can mtshun zas spyod pa ltar// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal thabs skyong gang tshe// mong rtul gsol ham bgyis pa gang dang gang*// sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan gyi dkyus// mtha' klas shes bya'i yul la bsrings pa'i lam// dpyad gsum dag pa'i legs bshad 'phang 'gro'i rgyud// snyan dgu 'khrol ba mnyan bdag skal ba srom// chu skyes ge sar bcud bsdus bh+ra ma ras// mgrin rnga brdung ba'i nga rgyal mthar 'dzegs na// mkha' 'gro sdud byed dam tshig bcud len sogs// byin rlabs dngos skyes thob bdag cis mi rgyags// 'dir 'khod 'byung lnga tshogs pa'i 'dam bu'i khyim// nye zhos gnyis 'thung dregs pas ma bcom pa// 'di yang skyabs mchog thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// nyer btab bran du bkol drin nges par khums// slad char rtse gcig sol 'debs snye ma ni// gangs can ljongs kyi lung rtogs bstan pa dang*// lus can bcas pa'i phan bde'i sgo 'phar brgya// 'byed pa'i nyag gcig skyabs kun 'dus pa gang*// mi pham rgyal bas legs gsungs rta ljang can// yong ye shar ba de srid sku gsung thugs// gzhom bral zho 'thung rus pa'i rtse brgya pa'i// sra brtan rang bzhin bcud len bsgrub pa dang*// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od brgyas legs bshad kyi// 'od zer thigs pas sems rgyud sbrang rtsi'i snod// nyer lhung don gnyis grub pa'i 'dab brgya pa// 'dzum par dmul ba'i ngo mtshar rjes su skyongs// dkar 'jam zla zhal tshogs gsum ri dwags gzugs// rnam bkra mkhyen rab mkha' dkyil 'degs mtshon du// tsī na'i 'phrul dar mdog bzang dngul srang bcas// gus 'bangs tshul khrims rin chen bod de yis// rab byung 'dod par nyer son bgrang ba'i gzhi// dbang thang lo ha'i khams bskrun dbyar gyi rnga// zhag gi phung po thub pa'i gral tshes bzang*// dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis par gus pas phul// zhes rnam gnon gyi lor dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phul ba'i zhu yig ri dwags gzugs can zhes bya ba 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa bkra shis par gyur cig/

// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ snang byed 'od kyis pad+ma rā ga'i rdul brtsegs rir// lan brgyar dkris pa'i mtshar sdug mtshon min gang gi sku// bsam gtan pir gyis bris tsam 'chi med rdo rjer byed// tshe mtha' yas pas nyi bu'i dpung las rnam rgyal mdzod/ 1 /dpag yas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa las// mkhas tshul dri med gsum gyi 'od rnon ring 'phro bas// chos dang sems can phan bde'i 'dab ma brgya ldan tshal// 'dzum dkar bsu ba mchog gi sprul sku'i nyin mor byed/ 2 /gang gi bgrod byed zung gi ban+du dzī wa kas// rnam par bkod pa bskal pa'i srid du brling byed pa'i// bsnyengs bral gdong lnga'i dbang pos mtshan pa chos kyi khri// lhar bcas skye dgu'i spyi bos btud pa ga la bar/ 3 /srid par skye ba'i dbyar skyes phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i khrod// dal 'byor rten gyi lo 'dab sdong bu phra ldem rtser// shākya'i btsun gzugs 'chang gi chu skyes dgod pa las// snyan dngags rgyud las 'phos pa'i rkang drug dbyangs 'di 'bul/ 4 /grangs med skye ba'i tshogs gnyis rin chen 'byung gnas che// smon lam rmad byung rdul gyi rgyal mtshan gyis bsrubs pas// rgyal kun thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul zlos pa'i lhun po 'khrungs// dge mtshan dpe byad nyin mtshan mgon po'i sba ba can/ 5 /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i rtsa lag gdung 'tshob bcas rnams kyis// legs gsungs chos kyi phung po ji snyed dpal mgur las// tha dad gdul bya'i blor 'tsham blangs pas 'dzad min pa'i// ngo mtshar 'di sprul sngon sbyangs byed po de re mkhas/ 6 /blo ldan yongs kyis bslab byar gyur pa shes bya'i gzhung*// tha dad bzhed pa ma 'dres mkhyen pa'i klong chud pa// thams cad mkhyen pa kun gyi sgrib bral ye shes kyi// gzigs pa rab gsal khong las yong ye phyung ba bzhin/ 7 /stobs sogs yon tan bsam mi khyab pas sems can gyi// re ba 'gengs pa'i chos de nga la yod snyam du// yongs 'du'i 'khri shing snyems pa skyungs shig rgyal kun gyi// lhun grub bsam kun rdzogs pa'i tshul la'ang srid phyir ro/

8 /gser gyi mngal can bka' yis phab pa ma yin zhing*// drang srong khros pa'i kha chus sbags pa'i skyon med par// rgyun chags lhun grub mdzad pa'i skal ldan shing rta yis// mtha' yas gdul bya'i lha bu'i sgrib pa bcad cing zos/ 9 /mngon par rgyu'o phyogs bcur rdul gyi rgyal mtshan can// ri gling yul gru kun tu ma zlum 'od kyi zer// dzam+bu ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling gi khongs yangs su// skyabs gcig khyod kyi mkhas tshul bzang po'i snang bas so/ 10 /ri dwags mig can sgyu rtsal tshogs kyis 'drid ma byas// yid srubs byed po grogs su bkug pa yang med par// mthong thos tsam gyis khengs ldan bye ba'i brtan pa dag /rang dbang phrogs pa'i 'phrin yig phyogs kyi rna bar 'jebs/ 11 /gang sku dge legs mtshan ris gsal ba'i ngo mtshar tsam// bsngags brjod yul du bgyid snyam kun rtog 'di ko ci// rnam 'dren zhing gi yon tan bkod pa dpag yas kyang*// sku yi cha rer rdzogs pa'i tshul la bsam kyin dad/ 12 /tshe rabs kun dang mthong ba'i chos 'dir 'dus byas pa'i// rnam dkar dge ba ji snyed ri gling dag byed gter// lam gsum 'byung po'i dpal 'byor ma tshang med sprul nas// bsam gyis mi khyab yon gnas mchog gi spyan sngar 'bul/ 13 /'dag chal bcas pa'i chu yis bkrus kyang gtsang mi bzod// snang byed 'od kyis dbrog nus min pas dge ba'i phyogs// mog por bgyid pa sgo gsum rnam par gnag pa'i las// gang dag bsags pa stobs bzhi tshang ba'i cho gas bshags/ 14 /'khor ba mya ngan las 'das rgyud kyi sa gzhi la// bsod nams tshogs kyi nyal 'gro'i rgyun chen 'khyil ba der// sdang sems gnyis 'thung dregs pas rnyog par mi byed cing*// yid rang zla gzhon 'od zer spro bas 'phel bgyi'o/ 15 /gzhan don khur khyer snying stobs phrag pa brling ba khyod// spros pa'i gzugs sku myang 'das dbyings su brtul mi bya// ci phyir rtsom pa 'di 'dras thog ma'i thugs bskyed kyi// g.yar dam yi ge thugs kar bkod don ya ma brla/

16 /'dzum sgros ut+pal dmar po bzhad pa'i khong gsing nas// dbyangs kyi cha rdzogs bung ba'i bu mo khengs ldan mas// sna tshogs sems can skal bar 'tsham pa'i legs bshad glu// dpyad gsum dag pa'i snyan 'gyur dbyangs su longs shig gu/ 17 /chu klung mang po ā gasta yi ltor song ba'i// nus pas nad 'joms bdud rtsi skyugs pa'i gtam rgyud kyis// 'dis mtshon bsod nams tshogs kun byang chub chen po'i rgyur// yongs bsngo des ni gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub 'gyur mtshon/ 18 /thugs rje che ldan khyod kyi mdzad pas mngon gyur dus// phyag na pad+ma'i byang chub spyod mtha' rmad byung spyad// skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs gyur skye bo dbugs kyang phyung*// rnam 'dren mchog bstan ring 'tsho'i sman pa'i mchog kyang byas/ 19 /'o ma'i rang bzhin dug can gnas las blangs pa med// legs bris yul gyi bgo skal las kyang ma phrogs par// ci 'dod rtag 'jo dpag bsam dbang po yod bzhin du// mngon 'dod phyogs re'i yul la snyim pa ci phyir skyong*/ 20 /skyabs kyi mchog gyur gang gis ring nas smon pa'i lam// dpag yas snye ma dus 'dir g.yur du za ba yi// spyod pa phul byung sku drin gzugs su bgyir btub na// srid gsum yangs pa'i snod 'dir chud pa'i dus nam zhig 21 /su zhig mthong don snying po mi dman bzhin gyi zla// 'dren byed rdzing bur shar ba'i gya nom dga' ba 'di// 'byung 'gyur bskal pa ji srid 'tsho gzhes bzhugs pa las// nges par thob kyi gzhan du skye bar btsal mi rnyed/ 22 /deng 'dir zhal bzang skal ba yangs pa'i mig lam du// shar ba'i sku drin gsob mtshon cung zad stob pa la// ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan zur lhung ba'i 'bab kyi stegs// thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi na ci gnang lags/ 23 /de'ang thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs bri/

tshan bcas 'di ngor gyi mkhan zur dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i sku tshar gyur pa'i btsun pa rin chen mchog grub tu bod pas gus phyag dang chabs gcig tu 'bul bar thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas spyan zur gyis gzigs pas lhung ba'i bka' drin chen pos skyong ba mkhyen mkhyen lags/ dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig ces pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdan tshab tu mnga' gsol ba'i de mo mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'bul tshan gyi gong brjod snyan dngags rkang drug glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni sku dbon rin chen mchog grub pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ che mchog yon tan cha shas yid kyi gzhir// dad gsum smyu gus bris nas gsol btab kyis// yi ge'i snye mas dud byed dkon mchog gsum// kun 'dus bdag nyid che khyod rgyal gyur cig /rgyal kun ye shes me long snyigs ma 'dir// yid srubs thul gyi gdung 'tshob zlos pa'i gar// lung rtogs chos kyi snang ba yongs bzung nas// 'gro tshogs srid las gdon nus thugs rje'i gter// gang gi zhabs stegs mdog bzang ba gam ngos// srid zhi'i dpal gyis khengs ldan gus pa yi// thal sbyar gyis btud gzugs brnyan bye ba brgya// bkrag cher snang ba'i bzhin snod ga la bar// srid par skye ba'i nags khrod dge sbyong gi /brtul zhugs tshul 'chang chu skyes ldem pa las// so 'dzum dmul ba'i ge sar dgod pa'i khrod// gus skyes snyan dngags bung ba'i dbyangs chung 'bul// tshes rab brgyud mar 'du byas lhas bskos kyis// mngon par bskrun pa'i dge mtshan rdzogs pa'i sku// mi sbyin skyes 'od stong gis gser gyi rir// lan mang 'khyud pa ji bzhin lham mer gsal// shes bya'i yul gyur thams cad lam srol bzung*// sgra don gab tshig rgyud las 'phos pa'i dbyangs// gzhar yang 'dzad pa med pa'i rgyun 'jo bas// skal ldan shing rta'i grags pa thung ngur byas// dpag yas mkhyen brtse nus pas ring song ba'i// pha rol mthong 'dod grags pa'i mu khyud kyis// lta byid dbang po stong du sprul byas kyang*// ma rtogs mtshang de rig byed gtam gyis bsgribs// tsha ba'i gdung bsil bdud rtsi'i zer phreng gis// phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'gengs mod sgrib pa gsum// 'phrog min mkha' yi rna ba mkhas khyod kyi// lhun grub mdzad pa'i tshul las shin tu dman// gru 'dzin ri bo'i bdag po rgyal ba'i dbang*// gang gi snying rje'i chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// zla bral mchog gi sprul sku'i bdud rtsi'i zer// thub bstan bde 'byung ral rtser spud pa'i tshe// lung rtogs bstan pa dri med sa dga'i tshal// klog spang 'khor lo'i 'dab brgya grol ba'i bcud// skye dgu'i tsa ko ra tshogs kyis btung bas// bde skyid lang 'tsho dar bab khyod kyi drin// de sogs rgyal kun ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar// gang 'tsham srid par bsgyur ba'i 'phrin shod la// gser mngal gtam gyi 'bab stegs bzhi bsgyur yang*// mthar ma son pas gnyid du ci ste yur// lung rtogs yon tan 'bod grogs gzugs brnyan brgyas// kun nas bskor ba'i khyad par 'phags blo yi// añja na bu min pas nges pa nyid// dpyod pa'i nus pas dben snyam thal sbyar btud// rgyal kun 'dus zhal gang gi spyan lam du// srid pas sprul pa'i mchod 'bul rin che ba'i// khengs pa ring du skyungs shig ba spu'i gor// srid zhi'i 'byor pas gtams kyang ngoms pa ci// skye ba lu gu rgyud nas da lta'i bar// rang bzhin bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba// mthong chos slad mar bcas pa'i bde legs dpal// dbrog pa'i chom rkun blta ba'i sems kyis mthol// 'phags dang so skye'i rgyud kyi zhing sa la// legs byas dbyar skyes myu gu bskyed bsring phyir// yi rang sprin gyi 'thor yab gyis gtor chus// rang gzhan dge ba'i lo tog ci yang spel// gzhan don khur chen khyer khyod sprul pa'i gzugs// myang 'das dbyings su brtul la ci ste spro// tshul 'dis 'gro rnams yongs su ma grol bar// 'gro don bsgrub pa'i g.yar dam dral gyis dogs// legs pa'i lam stor snyigs mar 'phyan rnams la// theg gsum chos sgo grangs med mi 'byed ci// mong rtul rigs mthun khrod du yur ba'i las// smra mchog rnams kyis mi 'os pa min nam// tshul 'dis nyer mtshon dge ba'i dag byed rgyun// 'khor gsum sgyu ma'i rtse 'jos byang chub kyi// rgya mtsho la sim yid can thams cad kyi// ci 'dod nor bu'i 'byung gnas nyid gyur cig

/snying rjes 'gro la chags pa'i shing rtar brten// gang 'dul 'tsham pa'i sprul sku'i nor bu yis// mgon med skye bo sdug bsngal dbugs rab 'byin// thub pa'i lugs mchog ring 'tsho'i sman pa byas// shin tu brling ldan yal ga phyogs su rgyas// mngon 'dod snye ma mi zad 'gro la 'gyed// kun gyis ngal gsor 'os pa'i grib bsil can// dpag bsam ljon pa'i mchog khyod skal bas rnyed// zhal bzang zla ba nam zhig mthong gyur zhes// ring nas yi ge'i bzlas brjod lhur blangs pa// bdag cag rnams kyi mig yul da lta nyid// mngon gyur dga' ba'i dpal 'di khyod drin khums// slad kyi char yang rgyal kun thugs rje'i gzugs// srid pa mtha' can ma gyur de srid du// brtan byed cho ga tshe mtha' yas pa sogs// mgrin bsgrigs tshangs pa'i dbyangs su sgrogs shig kye// dad dga' rgyas pa'i rdo rje glu len mas// mdun 'jog phra mo'i stegs la ngal gso zhing*// shis brjod bsngags pa'i rgyud stong 'khrol ba la// ye shes gzigs pas 'jug par gsol kyin mchis// de'ang thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs/ bcas 'di ngor gyi mkhan zur dpal ldan chos skyong ba'i sku tshar gyur pa btsun pa rin chen mchog grub can gyis gus phyag dang lhan cig tu 'bul ba ye shes gzigs pa dam pa'i 'bab stegs su 'cha' ba'i bka' drin chen pos bskyang ba mkhyen mkhyen lags/ zhes rnam gnon zhes pa'i gnam lor gtsang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul skur 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig bung ba'i dbyangs chung zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ sku dbon 'dren mchog rin chen mchog grub pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ dpag yas byin rlabs 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// 'dod pa'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i yi dam lha// dran pas 'jigs sgrol bstan srung rgya mtsho rnams// deng 'dir shis pa'i me tog stsol la spyon// grangs med skye ba'i sems rgyud las bzang gi

/byed pos legs brdal bsod nams yangs pa'i mtha'// tshad la blang 'dod kun gsal sgeg mo 'dis// rang lus yangs par sprul snyam mi bdag che// bstan srid pha rol dpag dka'i dga' tshal dag /mdzes byed dal 'byor lo 'dab cher rgyas pa'i// dge legs 'dod dgu mi zad rtag 'jo ba'i// sa skyong rigs kyi dpag bsam yongs 'du gang*// srid 'di byams chen chos kyi zla gzhon 'od// yongs su rdzogs min de srid sa spyod dbang*// sngon bsags snye ma rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs// mi shigs rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang du// gzhar yang 'pho 'gyur bral bar ches brling bar// sku tshe sra brtan bsring ba'i cho ga de// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i pha rol ring song ba// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas sgrubs shig gu// gcig tu byams brtse'i dpyid dus mdza' na mos// bden gnyis byang sems dbyar skyes mgron du bkug /bskyed rdzogs lta ba'i me tog rgyan phreng ngom// don gnyis grub pa'i snye ma g.yur za shog /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mchog rnams kyi// lugs bzang bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len bcas// gser ldan thig le 'di nas 'od srungs byin// dkyil 'khor kun du khyab par rgyas par shog /bsod nams gnam gyi mthongs nas legs byin pa// sde bzhi dge bcu dar ba'i bstan jus 'bangs// thams cad rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar bab de// 'di na yongs su rdzogs snyam nyid du shog /yid 'phrog chu skyes 'dab stong rgyas pa'i bcud// ris bral rkang drug ngom pa med 'thungs ltar// thugs brtse'i sgo brgya phye ba'i dpal 'byor gter// bdag sogs 'gro bas rtsen pa'i gzhir gyur cig /gang sku bskal par mi 'gyur lhun po'i dpal// co 'drir bgyid pa shis pa'i cho ga mkhan// nor bu'i rkang stegs dam par rdo rje yis// re khās bkrag tu che byas ga la bar// srid zhi'i dpal gyi snye ma rdzogs min yang*// yongs 'dzin che mchog rigs kyi nags khrod du// skye ba'i sdong bu bzung des sor bcu yi// me tog mngon par dgod pas 'di skad gsol// zhes shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nyung ngu sngon du btang nas gsol ba/

gtsug lag lugs brgya dpyod pa'i mkhyen rab dwangs shel me long ngogs su nges par bkrag tu che ba snang ltar/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po de nyid nas/ bka' lung gi bkod pa dag tu ji ltar gsal bar bris pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub dgos kyi rim par/ 'di phyogs kyi dgos rigs rnams nas/ rgyal ba byams chen gyi sku brnyan dang lam 'bras gdan rabs kha skong gi gser sku gnyis min pa ha lam grub rtsis dang*/ da cha dbus gtsang phyogs su sngon chad mgyogs sngo'i rigs kyis gtsos pa'i rags bsdus min pa ma grub pas/ de'i phyir da lam ci snga zhig de dag phyogs su bteg rtsis lags pas/ de sngon dbon ming can bdag kyang dbus gtsang phyogs su dgongs rdzogs bsgrub pa dang chab cig par 'degs rgyu'i dbang gis/ sku drin gzhal du med pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sa skyong chen po'i sku mdun du snyan gsan stob pa dang bskal par 'tsho gzhes kyi shis brjod gsol ba'i rten/ tshe rab cig 'byor rgyu byung na 'das bzhugs kun la rnam kun thugs rje che skyong gi sku drin gsob tu med phyir dgos nges lags kyang*/ gtsang dbus phyogs kyi bla dpon dgon sde spyi bye brag pa kun du dgongs rdzogs sgrub yul mang bas dngos rdzas gtong sgo che ba thugs la mnga' bzhin lags pas dgongs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las khrel rlabs mi g.yo ba nas/ 'dir mtshon byed tsam du bkra shis pa'i re khās sgeg ldan lha dar dkar po sogs bris so// rnam grangs tshan bcas phul ba thugs brtse'i klong yangs nas bzhes pa dang*/ slad kyi char yang*/ bstan srid yangs pa'i rtsa lag gcig pur gyur pa'i sa skyong chen po'i gzugs sku rin chen lhun po lta bur brtan pa'i thabs la nam yang mi g.yel ba nas/ ngos cag rnams su'ang bla ma gong ma'i chos dam tshig la dgongs pas rtag tu thugs brtse'i spyan ras kyi gzigs pas mi bor ba'i bka' drin che ba dang*/

'phral du'ang rje btsun dam pa nyid nas bka' phebs nang 'khod ltar lam 'bras gdan rabs kha skong gi gser sku gsar bskrun skor gyi bkod khyab lhod med dang*/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs rdzogs dus ja'i kha gsos byed pa'i 'bul sdud par chos rje mnga' ris pa rin chen chos dar can dpon g.yog nyung shas bzhag pa 'di par yang rtag tu mgo 'dren bdag rkyen mi chung ba sogs gang ci'i phyogs su rmad byung thugs rje'i chu 'dzin stug po'i khrod nas dge lam sman 'dogs bzang po'i char gyi rgyun chen 'bebs pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes dbon rin chen mchog grub can gyis gus par phul ba lags/ zhes pa 'di ni sku dbon rin chen mchog grub pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang dag che ba'i yon tan cha shas 'phrin// dad gsum smyug gus yid kyi gzhir bkod cing*// ci 'dod smon lam 'grub byed dkon mchog gsum// deng 'dir shis pa'i me tog stsol la spyon// snang byed 'char ka'i dpal las 'phos 'dra'i sku// bsams kyin yid skyob brag ca'i dbyangs zlos tsam// 'chi med dpal sbyin dpag yas tshe yi lhas// sa skyong dral lcam ring 'tsho'i dngos grub stsol// rnam 'dren ring lugs dri med de 'dzin bcas// srung skyob dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa ba nas// bstan srung dbang po rnams kyis sa gzhi skyongs// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i cho ga sgrubs// skye 'gro'i smon lam mthun pa'i shing rta yis// rdzogs ldan bskal par 'os pa'i 'khor los sgyur// 'di na mgron du gnyer byas rgyal ba'i sras// byams bstan ma shar de srid brtan gyur cig /gtsug lag gsum gyi brjod bya smra sgo nas// sdeb legs snyan ngag dam pa'i glur 'jo ba'i// dbyangs snyan skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun bzhin du// 'dzad med lam gsum khongs na gsal gyur cig

/skyes sbyangs dag pa'i blo gros me long du// bden gnyis shes bya'i gzugs brnyan yongs shar ba'i// ya mtshan rnam dpyod mig gi ltad mo'i dpyid// bkrag tu che gang sgrib pas dben gyur cig /las dbang mi dman gom pas chab 'babs kyi// dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor gzhal la ches bdo ba'i// gegs byed stobs ldan dpung tshogs sa 'og tu// nges par gnon pa'i stobs rdzogs dga' byed lha// gang gi bgrod byed chu skyes dmar po'i 'dab// 'pho bral bskal pa'i 'gram dkyus ring mo'i bar// brtan byed bkra shis rtags kyis spud pa'i khri// mang po'i yan lag mchog btud ga la bar// mi dman rigs kyi sā la'i nags khrod du// skye ba phal gyi dbyar skyes ldem pa'i phang*// zol bral gus pa'i yal 'dab kyis btud cing*// tshogs gsum me tog 'dzum pas 'di skad gsol// deng dus skyabs gcig rdo rje 'chang zhes je mtho'i rigs kyi skye ba'i yal ga las rnam par mched kyang*/ blo gros dang stobs 'byor gyi lcug phran gzhon nur gyur pa kho bo cag rnams/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang yon tan ldan pa'i mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs bsgrub bya/ mdo khams ljongs kyi phyogs 'dir rang mkhos gang theg cig bsgrubs zin pa'i khul lags mod/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs char sngon chad mgyogs bsngo snyan 'bul gyi rten tsam min pa ma grub pa ni mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor du rnam par bkra ltar lags pas/ da lam thugs dgongs rdzogs byed kyi dngos gzhi rnams gang 'grub cig sgrub 'dun chen pos/ yul dbus gyur 'chang gi phyogs su bteg rtsis lags par/ da lam byams brtse yangs pa'i gur khyim las rtag tu ma bor bar/ thugs rje dang bka' drin gzhal du med pas lan brgyar bskyangs pa'i sa skyong chen po'i drin lan gyi mtha' tshad ni skye ba'i phreng ba du mar bsabs kyang 'tshob tu ci zhig mchis/

'on kyang lhag bsam dag pas kun nas bslangs pa'i shis brjod smon lam gsol ba'i 'bras bu ni gzhar yang med par mi 'gyur ba ni dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i chos nyid yin pas/ sa skyong rgyal ba'i myu gu pa chen po lcam dral 'khor bcas dbyig 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa na mtshungs pa med pa'i stobs kyi 'khor los bdag gir bgyid cing*/ rnam dkar phrin las kyi snang ba dkar pos phyogs kyi pha mthar nyul ba la nam yang bsdo ba med cing*/ sku gsung thugs nam yang 'gyur med zho 'thung rus pa'i rdo rje'i khams su bskal pa nam zhig gnas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs pa'i shis brjod smon lam gsol ba'i mtshon byed tsam du lha dar dkar po bkra shis pa'i re khās sgeg pa sogs bcas phul ba byams brtses legs par phye ba'i thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis gzigs pa'i 'bab stegs su 'cha' zhing*/ rnam pa thams cad du brtse ba'i mas gces pa'i bu bzhin bskyangs pa la bka' drin dam pa'i klong nas nam yang ma bor ba mkhyen mkhyen zhes dbon ming 'dzin pa rin chen mchog grub ces bgyi bas gsol gyin gda' ba lags so// zhes pa 'di'ang sa skyong bla ma chen po'i sku zhabs su dbul byar/ sku dbon dam pa rin chen mchog grub pa'i gsung bskul gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang zhig dad gsum sor rtse yis// gang mtshan rgyud mangs 'khrol tsam gyis// gang 'dod snying po de de'i char// gang yang 'bebs pa dkon mchog gsum// deng 'dir gser ldan lus phra'i bzhin// rdzogs par stobs kyi tsakra yis// dbang sgyur lha sras lha lcam bcas// rgyal gyur tshangs dbyangs glu ru longs// nyi 'od kyis khyab byi ru'i ri'i// mtshar sdug la sdang mig gi dpyid// bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas pa yis// sku tshe bskal pa'i ring 'tsho sgrubs// ye shes ral gris gti mug gi

/'khri shing gcod mdzad lhag pa'i lhas// mchog zung shes bya'i gnas kun la// chos mig rdul bral dkyus su srings// legs byas pho nyas mgron gnyer ba'i// dpal gyi 'byung gnas lha lcam gyi// gzugs sku'i yid bzhin nor bu dag /'pho med bskal par brling ched du// sna tshogs rin thang che ba'i dbyig /dpag yas brtsegs pa'i rkang stegs zung*// khengs ldan skye bo grangs med kyis// yan lag mchog btud ga la bar// byams brtse'i gdugs dkar g.yo ba'i grib// bde bar ngal 'tsho dge sbyong gi /brtul zhugs 'chang ba spun dag gis// rab dgar brtas pa'i mchid 'di gsol// sngon bsags sa bon stobs po che// smon lam dpyid kyi rgyang glu yis// nyer bkug chos dang srid pa'i dpal// 'dzad med 'jo ba'i dpag bsam dag /bskal par 'tsho gzhes bcud len gyi// cho ga rgyal ba sras dang bcas// dbyings nas dgyes pas bsgrubs min na// ya mtshan 'di 'dra su las thob// ris bral skye 'gro'i smra sgo las// so phreng dga' ba'i 'dzum zer gyis// phyogs kyi mun pa bkru snyam la// blta phyir lha rnams mkha' la lhags// legs dgu phun sum tshogs dus 'dir// rang skal 'tsham pa'i zang zing las// dga' ston chung ngu'i me tog gi /sil mas 'thor ba 'di ltar lags// bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po zhes sogs brgyad kyis lhag pa'i brgya phrag gcig gi rnam grangs bcas phul ba lags/ smras pa/ dge ba sum ldan chos dang thar pa'i sde// 'dzad med nor dang 'dod pa'i sder bcas pa// rtag tu ches cher 'phel ba dge legs kyi// cho ga dkon mchog gsum gyis sgrubs shig gu// zhes sde dge sa skyong yab sras lha lcam thun mong du dga' ston mdun 'jog 'bul ba'i gong brjod nyung ngu 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas lhun grub steng gyi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//

༄༅// skyabs gsum riṃn cheṃn yongs 'dus bdag nyid che ba'i cha// miṃ 'aṃgyur phreng du dngar ba'i khur gyis gser mngal can// ches cher dub pa'i lus kyis sbrang rtsi'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn la// ngal gsor bgyid snyam rnam par 'dren gang rgyal gyur cig /rnam 'gyur bzhin las sdang mig dmar pos gtsubs pa med// rtsub mo'i yi ge bsgrags pas snying gar ma bsnun par// mda' lnga'i bdag po'i dpung tshogs las ni gcig pu nyid// rnam par rgyal gyur 'jig rten gsum mgon shāṃkya'iṃ togaṃ /thub gsung dri med mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i lam chen nas// bde bar bsnyad la gzhan dring mi 'jog mkhas pa'i tshul// 'dzam gling rgyan mchog kun gyi 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i blo// spungs las blangs bzhin smra dbang saṃ skya'iṃ dadaṃ sgrolaṃ lngaṃ// de bstan yang dag 'doms la mkhas rlom laṅka'i bdag /rtog brtag tshig gi gzugs brnyan brgya phrag sprul byas kyang*// dpyad gsum rnam dag dgag sgrub nyag phran bsnun 'phral du// rdzun gtam gzugs brgya cig car gzhil ba kunaṃ dgaṃ' bzaṃng*// gang de'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul rol pas srid pa 'dir// skye ba legs blangs bkra shis pad+ma'i ngo mtshar dran// chos 'dul bstan pa'i bslab gzhi yongs bzung 'chad pa la// dgra bcom nye 'khor btsun dang mkhas pa'i tshul la reg /ring nas tshogs gnyis riṃn thang gzhal med cheṃn po yis// mngon par bskrun pa'i sku gsum mi 'gyuraṃ go 'phang mchog /dbang 'byor na yang theg gsum chos kyi tshul smra bas// rgyalaṃ ba'i bstan pa 'jig rten snang byed mtshanaṃ nyid rdzogs// rab 'byams zhing gi gnyis med gsung ba ji snyed kyi// byin rlabs mtha' dag gcig gyur skyabs kun 'dus sku la// dog bral tshul du chud pa'i mtshar la rnam 'dren kun// dgyes pa'i bsngags brjod gsang chen rgyud sde'i khrod du 'jibs// kun gyi rnar snyan gan+dharba yi lus phra'i dbyangs// chos dang chos min rnam 'byed bya ba'i khur bzod na// mkhas dbang khyod kyi tha dad gzhung gi bzhed pa'i tshul// 'gal 'brel brtsad dang brtsams pa'i legs bshad rjes su snyegs// 'gro ba'i blor 'tsham don bzang 'dren par 'chad pa'i gsung*// yid 'ong chab sgra dang bcas lam gsum 'bab kyi rgyun// gang gsung thos pas rgyud gsum dri sbyang bde legs ster// cig shos sgrib pa bkru 'dod rig byed rdzun pa'i gtam// sgrib bral mkhyen rab kun gsal chu gter dwangs pa'i klong*// mtha' klas gtsug lag mi ltung phreng gzugs bye ba bkra// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin lang ling rlabs kyi tshogs g.yo bas// phan bde'i gru char rin thang che dgu'i 'byung gnas bzang*// brtse dang byang sems zung 'jug nor ldan brtan ma bzhin// nye 'khon dben par yid can skyong ba'i khur ni bzod// lus rten ring du 'tsho ba'i gsos sman cad 'gyed la// lan dang 'bras bur re bas dben pa'i ngang tshul bzang*// re ba 'gengs so bkres rngabs nyen pa'i lag rkyong dag

/ci 'dod 'jo ba dpag bsam yal ga brkyangs pa yis// zab yangs chos phyir lhags pa'i 'gro la mkhas khyod kyi// sdom gsum yan lag bcas pa'i dga' ston mi zad pas// gzhung mang thos bsam bsgom pa'i blo mchog brnyes gyur cig /da dung nyin mtshan 'bad rtsol bskyung du med pa ci// 'on te bslabs sbyangs rgyu rkyen tshogs las thams cad mkhyen// 'grub par legs rtogs dpyod ldan kun gyi las 'di yin// gzhan gsos rgyags pa'i rgyang gru yi ge dam pas dben// rang byung gsung snyan rnam grol phyogs rab snang mi byed// khyod gsung thos pa lhur byas mngon mtho nges legs kyi// 'bras bu bslu med yong ye ster phyir khyad par 'phags// brtse chen snying po e waṃ yi ges mtshan bstan bcas// skyong byed phrin las snang ba dkar po ring spros pas// yid srubs dga' bder rtsen pa'i bsti gnas ma rnyed par// bag med 'dod yon spyod pa'i gling gzhan nyul ba snyam// dpal stug bstan pa mkhas tshul gsum gyis bskyangs pa'i gtam// rtogs brjod rtsom la rgan po'i gzugs kyis theg dka' snyam// 'phyang mo nyug brten ma drug skyes ni gzhon nu'i lus// byin gyis rlob byed mgrin pa sngo de ma mkhas sam// gang sku'i che ba phyogs re mnyan pa'i mong rtul dag /bab col phyogs lhung 'ud gog rjes su rgyug pas ci// snying po mchog 'dzin grong khyer bye ba'i bdag po la// rgyal gsung yan lag drug cus bsngags pa la phyag 'tshal// bdag cag sngon skyer gtong ba phra mo'i legs byas mthus// mngon par sprul pa'i smar zong dngos po'i sdum ra nas// kun dga' brtas pa'i nang shes phreng brgyud mkhan ma yis// mdun 'jog me tog sna tshogs btus pa'i dngos 'bul gyis// nyer mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i ku sa la// mtha' dag chu gter ri gling snang byed lha mi'i dpal// maṇ+ḍal rnam par bskrun blo tshangs pa la yod kyang*// 'khor gsum sgyu ma'i rtse 'jor ma shes cung zad blun// rnam rig skyes bu dug gsum bza' bar rnam sred pas// dge sbyong spyod tshul rang lus 'od kyi snang ba brtul// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung mun par gom 'chol ba// mthol bshags dag pa'i tshangs par stsol cig rdo rje sems// srid pa mya ngan las 'das byed pos 'du bgyis pa'i// dge bar phrag dog mchu 'dab bskyod kyin mi bshung bar// legs byas tshul la dga' ba'i 'dzum zer spro ba dang*// bsod nams byas pa'i phan yon mchid du gleng bar dga'// gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa'i yol go tha dad dag

/kun nas gdengs pa de de'i skal par 'tsham pa'i chos// legs 'doms bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'jo bas thar pa dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob byed thabs kyi sman par bskul// thub dbang rgyal tshab khyed nyid kyis mtshon 'jig rten mgon// gang dag bzhugs dgur srid pa'i 'khor lo ma zhig pa// de srid rab brling 'tsho la gzhes pa'i gsol 'debs glu// mtsho byung lus phra dgyes 'dzum dmul ba'i snyan dngags byed// tshul 'di las skyes rnam dkar dge ba legs bris pa'i// lam mtha' mnyam pa nyid du song ba'i srog chags rnams// sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas las gdon pa'i thugs rje dang*// thabs tshul thams cad mkhyen pa 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo 'o// yid srubs thul mchog rnams kyis bskal mang mngon bsgrubs pa'i// sku gsum gsang ba mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// mgon khyod gcig pus bdag gir bgyid pa'i thub chod 'dis// snying rjes gzhan dbang gyur pa'i spyod tshul rnam par gnod// ma bos srid par lan mang 'phyan pa'i sems can khams// bskul ba med kyang phan par smra ba gang gi zhabs// ma bris dge mtshan ri mo bkra bas rnam bkod pa// mang pos ma bteg chos kyis mtho ba'i khri drung du// brgya lam bskal par thob dka'i rten// thub dbang nyi ma'i chos tshulaṃ gyi// bslab bya'i khrimaṃs sgor zhugs lo pa// mos gus riṃn cheṃn 'chang ba bdag /smra sgo'i ut+pal bzhad pa las// rab dga'i bcud myos bh+ra ma ras// skabs su babs pa'i mchid bu yi// mgrin pa'i rnga chung brdung ba snyan// 'brug sgras bskul ba'i gtsug phud can// bdud rtsi'i zer gyis tshangs pa'i bu// 'dren mchog thugs rje'i zer 'thungs pa'i// skal bzang dga' ba'i gar gyis brel// zhes pa ste/ de'ang thog ma'i tshigs su bcad pa phreng du bstar ba 'di dag ni/ gyi na tsam mam/ shes rlom gyi brda mtshon nam/

spros pa dang bcas pa'i chos su bsams nas smras pa min te/ gang gi phyir na/ 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni// snyan dngags mkhan tshe bde gshegs rtswa mchog la// tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang*// dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed do// zhes sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang byang chub tu thugs dang por bskyed pa'i rten/ snyan dngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod pa phul ba'i 'bras bu don med du ma song ba'i phyir/ 'dir yang gang zhig thar pa dam pa 'dod pas/ bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa nas/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub snying po'i bar gyi bde legs thams cad ster ba po yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ khyad par gsang chen rdo rje'i theg pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po/ skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid can/ gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mi zad rin chen 'byung gnas chen po'i 'gran zlar gyur pa las/ rang blo'i rtswa mchog 'thor yab kyi rtse mor chags pa'i thigs phran lta bu'i che ba'i cha shas tsam dran pa brjod bya'i ro dang ldan par/ dpal ldan daṇ+ḍī'i bzhed gzhung mtshar sdug dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i legs bshad kyi glu dang tam+bu ra'i dbyangs snyan lhan cig tu bsres pa snyam byed pa gang gi dum bu las nye bar 'phos pa'i shis brjod dang*/ phyag bya yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa snyan dngags dam pa'i mchod sprin spro ba ni/ ji skad du/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i bar gyi bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i sman yon rjes su dran pas sgo gsum ngal ba don yod du bgyis nas/

deng 'dir skabs gsum gyi dbang po dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ lto 'gro'i rgyal po la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum na che bar rlom zhing*/ mngon par khengs ldan rnams kyi do ker nor bu 'bar ba'i rtse mos mngon par bsten pa/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang*/ bzang po'i yon tan gyi phung pos mngon par 'byor ba'i bla mar gyur pa rnams kyis kyang bla mar mchod pa/ phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung gi gdengs can dbang po'i bsti gnas mang po brgal te don bzang nor bu'i dpal gyis srid zhi'i mi mthun rgud pa bcil ba la mkhas pa'i ded dpon chen po/ lus can mtha' dag ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi gdung ba mi bzad pa mtha' dag 'phrog par byed pa'i chos kyi sprin chen/ 'phags dang so skye'i dran pa'i dbang po kun gyis bsngags brjod snyan dngags lha'i me tog gsar pa bye bas mngon par 'thor bas mchod par byas pa/ dbang rnon gdul bya kun gyis bgrod pa gcig pa'i nye lam gsang rgyud rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bye ba'i gtso dang gnyis su min pa'i gar gyi rol pas/ skal ba bzang ldan gyi rgyud du mthar thug sku bzhi'i lam dang 'bras bu ci rigs par sbyor ba'i rigs brgya'i 'khor los sgyur ba shar chen chos kyi rgyal po gang der/ bka'i slob 'bangs rgan bu tshul khrims rin chen can bdag gis/ 'dus tshogs kyi dbur bzhugs phebs pa'i gsol ba 'debs kyin mchin ci gnang zhes gsol bar/ ring mo zhig nas brtse ba dang byang chub kyi sems kyis thugs rgyud shin tu mnyen par byas pa'i rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa chen po rnams ni/ 'jam mnyen dar gyi srad bu khab rjes su mi 'brang ba med pa ltar/ sems can mos pa'i phyogs su gzhar yang mi gzhol ba ci zhig yod de/ ji ltar gsol ba btab bzhin zhal 'ches yi ge dam pa'i gling bu bsgyur te/ gtsug lag khang chen po bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba gang der/

dpal lhun grub steng gi gdan sa chen por gnyug mar gnas pa'i yon tan gyi zhing du gyur pa'i chos rje rin po che rnams dang*/ bla ma dang dge 'dun rnams kyis mtshon/ dgon lag bdun dang bcas pa'i dge slong dang dge tshul gyi tshogs bsdus par/ 'du ba chen po zhes grags pa 'dus pa'i tshogs chen po'i ngur smrig tshon mdangs rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar/ sin+dhu wā ra'i chu gter chen po gang zhig yol med rlabs kyi phreng ba rnam par g.yo ba'i klong na/ mdog bzang gser gyi sa 'dzin dbang po la 'char ka'i nyi gzhon 'od kyis snang bas lan brgyar 'khyud pa ltar rin chen sau war+ṇa'i khri dam par lham mer bzhugs pa dang*/ 'dus tshogs lhan cig pas rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod bya ba'i rgyud kyis dngos bstan pad+ma'i rigs mchog bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub mchod 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang bcas pa bka' drin stsal bas nye bar mtshon/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas phal po cher/ rigs par ldan pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas na// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das te// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdor/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa'i// yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin// zhes bshad pa ltar/ yon gnas dam pa dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal sgrogs pa bcas la bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob pa la sogs pa rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge tshogs thams cad kho bo cag gis dmigs bya'i gtso bor/ sngon byon rgyal ba rnams kyis 'khor ba las ma bsgral ba'i mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed/ skad cig rer yang mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam dang 'bras bur sbyor ba la lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mnga' ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob dgos pa ni/

dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor mnga' ba ltar mngon par 'dod pa gor ma chag mod/ re zhig smon pa'i snye ma bla na med pa nyid g.yur du za bar byed pa la/ tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa zab yangs smon lam du bcas pa'i rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i stobs kun nas yongs su ma rdzogs pa de srid du 'gyang bar 'gyur ba zhig na'ang*/ srid par skye ba brgyud mar byang chub kyi spyod pa rmad byung gi chu klung ji snyed sdud pa'i snying stobs kyis tshogs zung gi rgya mtsho chen po bla nas bla mar 'gengs phyir/ dpal mgon 'phags pas/ ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang*// gang du ma grol de srid du// de phyir bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa'i rjes su slob cing rjes su sgrub pa'i rigs can du gyur nas snying las chung ngur mi gnas par/ mgon po byams pas/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi// blo ldan mchog de dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes// bdag gzhan sna tshogs 'ching bas rab bcings pa// brtson pa brgya 'gyur du ni bya ba'i rigs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ stobs bcu mnga' ba mchog gyi lung rtogs kyi chos tshul ring du gnas pa'i bya ba yang dag par bgyid pa dang*/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde rgyu dang bcas par 'god pa'i byed por 'grub pa'i rgyur smin pa dang*/ mthong ba'i chos kyi dal rten bskyed pa'i pha ma dang*/ kho bor re ltos bcas pa'i gson gshin gyi 'gro ba phan gnod las kyi 'brel pa srad bu dkar nag gis sbrel ba gang dag mchis pa rnams kyis thog drangs/ skye 'gro thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i bde ba la reg pa'i rgyur smin pa'i yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs kyi rjes su gzung 'gyur bcas pa'i thugs rje dang sku drin yangs par gdal ba'i kho lag gzhal du btub na/

sngo bsangs kun gsal sgeg mo'i gzhu 'dom brgya phrag gis kyang mthas gtugs bzod pa ci zhig de lta na'ang deng sku drin che ba'i legs so 'bul mtshon du bkra shis re khās spras pa'i lha dar dkar po/ sku rten thub dbang sku/ gsung rten 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po'i mdo/ thugs rten phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa rdo rje dril bu gser rtsi ma/ dbu la rgyun gsol gyi paṇa zhwa/ sku chas su gos stod/ sham thabs/ 'gan sbyar/ zhabs l+h+wam/ zhal dkar stegs bcas/ drag po'i mig tu grags pa'i phyag phreng rgyan ldan/ phyag ting legs pa dngul thag byi ru'i rgyan ldan bcas/ gos bzang bsgrigs kyi rten khebs/ byi ru rgya mo lag pa/ spos shel rdog po/ dngul gyi rna kor/ rgya sgam rtsi ma/ sman tse/ dar ling*/ a la cag dar man rnams yug re/ mdzod gos ser smug yug ring*/ la dā dkar po/ la dā khra bo/ a ti dkar po/ a ti dmar po/ 'ga' ras rnams yug re/ rgya ras sngon po/ ras ljang*/ ras ser/ ras nag ras dmar rnams yug re/ wa skyes dang*/ spre/ spyang ki g.yi/ gsa'/ sram/ gung*/ gzig rnams kyi pags pa re/ bu har ko ba bubs/ phrug dkar bubs/ mgo snam mtshal kha bubs/ rol mo hor sbub cha/ lo paṇa spyan 'dren gyi 'bud dung cha/ li 'dong*/ 'dong khra/ skyogs dkar/ spen par/ khro nag zangs dmar/ gser zho/ rgya dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa/ gzhung ja 'khor drug shan ja 'khor drug chung ju 'khor drug ko tse 'khor drug chibs sga gser srab smed ko stan gzar bcas 'khor tshang*/ chibs rta bzang ba/ chibs rol rta/ dre'u bzang ba/ mdzo/ g.yag ka ci dkar po yug ring bcas khyon rnam grangs brgya phrag gcig la bcu gsum gyis lhag pa bcas 'di dag bka'i slob 'bangs tshul khrims rin chen can gyis gus par phul ba dge slar yang smras pa/ a ho skye ba lu gu rgyud du lhas bskos kyi// bag chags mi nyung tsam zhig ma bzhag pa min na// deng 'dir gdan gsum lha yi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid che'i// g.yar lam bsod nams gsog pa'i rigs su son srid dam// rnam dkar 'di yis kun mkhyen bstan la blo mchog rnams// kunaṃ dgaṃ'i las byas srid pa gsum gyi snyingaṃ poṃ dang*// chos rnams thub dbang dngos dang dgongs gcig smra ba'i rgyal// kunaṃ bzaṃng che mchog zung gi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig

/riṃn cheṃn lhun po miṃ 'gyuraṃ skyabs mgon gzugs kyi sku// gaṅgā'i klung chen 'bab sgra'i gsung dang kun gsal thugs// dpag bsam yon tan nyi zla'i 'od kyi phrin las can// bdud las rgyaṃl ba'i dge mtshaṃn ldan pas bdag byin rlobs// tshul khrims bslab pas mngad pa'i bsung ldan ngur smrig 'chang*// 'dus tshogs gur gum nags klung stug pos kun bzod ma'i// dkyil 'khor yongs khyab bshad sgrub sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu yis// thabs shes yi ges mtshan bstan rgyas par byed gyur cig /sa gzhi gnon la sred med bu dang mi yi bdag /mtshungs kyang phun tshogs sdeṃ bzhir rtsen dang dgeṃ ba bcu'i// spyod tshul bsrungs pas khyad par rnam 'byed bloṃ groṃs can// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i gos can mdzes par rtag tu brling gyur cig /chosaṃ srid phrin las 'od srungs byin gyi dkyil 'khor yongs// bde bar skyong la legs bris mgoṃn poṃ'i sku tshe dang*// mnga' thang stobs 'byor ljongs kyi thig le 'dir lhags snyam// rgyal phran bye ba'i thor tshugs nor bus btud gyur cig /lo legs bde 'byor dar la bab pa'i mdza' na mo// srid pa tha gru yangs pa'i khab tu bkug pa la// chabs 'bangs kyis drangs lus can mtha' dag longs nyid du// spyod pa'i skal ba sbom po'i rtse 'jor rol gyur cig /bdag kyang 'gro ba 'dul mchog bsgrub phyir bsod nams kyi// gser ldan yangs par ring 'tsho tshe yi chu gter 'khyil// tshulaṃ khrimasaṃ bslab ldan dal rten rinaṃ cheṃn ri bo brling*// mkhas tshul spyod pa'i lha gnas grangs med 'degs par shog /ces pa shar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhan po chen po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa zhes yongs su grags pa nyid/ rab byung 'dod pa'i stod 'grel las nyi ma ste dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming na dī e ḍar bod pa'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi zhag gi phung po dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por/

lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang chen por dgon khag bdun gyi yon gnas 'dus pa'i tshogs su/ kho bos tshogs bsags ched du tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsung bskul dang bsnyen bkur stob pa'i tshogs dbur spyan drangs thob pa'i legs gsol gyi 'bul yig bh+ra ma ra'i mgrin rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bka'i slob 'bangs rgan bu tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder btags pa rang gis sug bris su bgyis nas bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po srid du ring ba bcas te phul ba dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren yon tan snyigs ma 'dir// 'gro 'dul smon lam rtsal gyis bskrun pa'i sku// bde chen snying po 'dzin pa'i grong khyer dbus// gtso bo'i gar gyis rnam rtsen rgyal gyur cig /nyi ma'i gnyen mchog sras dang bcas pa yi// ring lugs phan bde'i 'byung gnas gcig pu gang*// mkhas tshul gsum gyis shis pa'i sgo 'phar 'bum// cig car 'byed pa'i phrin las khyod rmad byung*// ci 'dod dpal gyi 'byung gzhi sa brtol dbang*// rtse gcig brtun pa'i mngon 'dod gsol btab pas// gnas skabs mthar thug dge legs ster bzod na// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i yon tan rjes su snyegs// phyi nang gtsug lag legs sbyangs mkhas pa'i rje// chos 'dul bslab gzhi 'dzin smra btsun pa'i mchog /brtse dang byang chub sems kyis lus can don// gzhar yang mi gtong bzang por grub pa'i phul// dpal stug bstan pa'i riṃn cheṃn 'byung gnas klong*// mtshan mchog lhun gyis grub pa'i mdog bzang ri// miṃ 'gyuraṃ bskal par brling ldan rgyalaṃ ba sras// ma lus 'dus pa'i dge mtshaṃn rdzogs pa gang*// gsang gsum mi shigs zho 'thung rus pa'i khams// brtan byed gdong lnga'i dbang pos nyer mtshan par// lhar bcas skye dgu'i yan lag mchog gi gzugs// grangs med 'char ba'i me long chos kyi khrir// rnam dkar dge bar 'dun pa'i 'dab brgya pas// zol bral dad pa'i ge sar dgod pa'i khrod// byang chub snying po mngon 'dod sbrang rtsi'i mgrin// legs byas de rgyur smin ched 'di skad gsol// de'ang deng rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa chu lug gi bgrang gzhi gsar tshes su/

chos kyi sbyin bdag sa skyong bla ma chen po dral lcam sku dbon rin po che bcas nas/ lor dar gyi dus mchod 'du ba chen por grags pa'i mchod gnas 'dus tshogs bsdus pa'i tshogs dbur/ brtan pa'i snang byed shar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ gdan gsum tshang ba lha'i 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can spyan drangs nas bzhugs pas mtshon/ ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun zhes grags pa'i gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams bzhengs te bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang bzhi blang ba la sogs pa rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya chen po bskrun pa'i skabs 'dir/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba gang*// byang chub ma thob bar du zad mi 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba'i rjes su 'brang ba bdag cag rnams nas kyang skyabs mchog rdo rje 'chang gtsos pa'i dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob par bcas pa'i dge tshogs kyi 'brel 'jog cung zad bgyis pas mtshon/ dus gsum kun du bsags pa'i bsod nams ji snyed bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur smin pa dang*/ gnas skabs kun du'ang tshul de nyid bsgrub par mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang bral zhing*/ mthun rkyen legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i bsngo ba smon lam du bcas pa'i thugs rjes bskyang bar zhu mtshon du/ bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs/ bcas pa'i tshan grangs 'di dag dpal spungs thub bstan gling nas/ dbon bsam gtan can gyis gus par phul ba lags/ zhes pa 'di'ang nyi ma zhes pa'i gnam lo gsar tshes su shar chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa nyid lhun grub steng gi 'du ba chen por grags pa'i tshogs dbur bzhugs pa'i legs gsol 'bul ba'i gong brjod du don gnyer gyi ngor/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// ༈ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes srid pa 'dir// bde chen snying po 'dzin pa'i grong khyer gtso// kun dang dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon rnams kyis// mchog sprul rtag tu shis pa'i cho ga sgrubs// phyogs dang phyogs bral zhing gi me long du// byon dang 'byon 'gyur da ltar 'tsho gzhes kyi// sgyu 'phrul las shar lus med thul gyi mchog /chos kyi snang byed 'gyed pa 'khor bcas dgongs// deng 'dir rgyal kun spyi gzugs rdzogs chen pa// bstan 'gror sman 'dogs dgongs pa'i mkha' dkyil nas// dge mtshan gsar pa'i bsil zer ngom bzhin du// yang 'byung sprul pa'i zla gzhon 'char ba gang*// 'khor bar mchog gi yang srid zlos pa'i gar// 'khrul bral ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i spyan// dkyus ring spros pa sa skya pa yi lung*// 'phrin snyan shod pa'i pho nya dang pos bstan// snying brtse'i gzhan dbang gyur pa rnams kyi sku// srid par gang 'dul skye ba'i gar gyis rtsen// kun phan dkyil 'khor gcig las dag byed snod// ji snyed gzugs brnyan 'phrul pa'i rjes su snyegs// sngon rabs skye ba'i rtogs brjod ci dang ci// skye ba'i sgrib pas ma nongs shugs 'byung nyid// legs 'doms blo ni 'jam dpal gzhon nu las// ma byin blangs pa yin snyam 'phyang mo nyug /rigaṃ pa 'dziṃn mchog grub pa'i phrinaṃ laṃs kyi// zla snang sa gsum 'gengs pa'i dbang phyugaṃ gang*// ches zab aṃ tiṃ bstanaṃ paṃ'i khang bzang rtser// sku yi rgyal mtshan dpal 'byor bzang po'i gter// gang de mi shigs bskal par brtan byed du// skye 'gro'i bsod nams rin chen su war+ṇa// mtha' dag gcig bsdus bsnyengs bral gdong lnga pas// sgeg byas chos kyi rkang stegs gang yin der// rtag par mthun pa min pa'i phyogs kun las// rnam par rgyal bar gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams// mdo sngags bstan pa'i snang byed kun gyi blar// shis brjod cho ga bye bas mnga' gsol la// mi mchog rnams kyi tshangs dbyangs bkra shis dung*// phan bde'i g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sbubs yangs nas// srid zhir dge ba'i dbyangs snyan ldir ba'i khongs// 'di na shis pa yang dag sgrubs shig kye// phyogs bral mkhas pa'i bsngags brjod snyan dngags kyi// puṇ+ḍa rī kas mngon par 'thor ba'i gnas// mchog gi yang srid dam pa'i zhabs kyi stegs// lhar bcas skye dgus btud pa de drung du// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon rgyags shing*// dge bcu'i spyod mdzes ljongs kyi thig le nas// sa skyong rigs kyi dpag bsam rkang 'thung gi

/yal ga ldem pa'i phang nas 'di skad gsol// zhes shis par brjod cing dngos po nges bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pa nyung zad sngon du btang nas/ skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/ deng dus mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i 'phrin yig ris bral sgra 'dzin dbang po'i gsos su 'jebs pa gang de/ kho bo pha mes bcas pa'i bla'i mchod gnas dam par thob cing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bka' drin zla med pas bskyangs pa'i 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid kyi gzugs sku/ tshur mthong skye bo'i blo'i yul las re zhig bskal ba'i tshul bstan pa de lta na'ang nyin mtshan snang ba'i sgron ma zung gis bgrod pa nam yang 'gog pa med ltar/ deng dus yang srid skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul phebs pa nyid/ shes byed du ma'i sgo nas bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser gyi dngos po'i rang mdangs 'tsher ba ltar skal ba mi dman pa'i lag rtser thob pa/ deng skabs chos rnams kun la chos mig dri bral brnyes pa'i rdzogs chen gong ma dag gi zhabs zung ut+pal dmar pos nye bar bkod cing theg mchog chos kyi sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa'i chos khri mthon po gang der/ rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las la dbang ba'i tshogs dang lhan cig pas spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar shin tu bkra shis pa'i cho gar mgrin bsgrigs nas mchod pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa bstab pa'i sgo nas mnga' gsol du yod pa ni/ kho bo cag ltos bcas kun gyi legs byas dman pa min pa'i mgron skal du thob pa dga' spro'i legs gsol dang khri 'bul maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed du bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs/ tshan 'di dag lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs thams cad las rgyal ba nas phul ba dge zhes pa sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po nas rdzogs chen yang srid sprul sku rin po che bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol ba'i legs 'bul stob pa'i tshe/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /swasti sid+dho bha wa tu/ dpal stug yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal// mtha' dag bsdus pa'i gar gyis skal ba can// byang chub snying por smin byed yon tan gter// skyabs mchog bla ma rnams kyis khyed la srungs// gang gi gsang gsum bsgom bzlas bgyis tsam nas// nyi bu'i dpung tshogs bsti ba'i gnas phrogs pa// tshe mtha' yas pa'i rgyal bas sprul pa'i sku// ring 'tsho tshe yi ka ring tshugs shig kye// deng 'dir bgrang yas skye ba'i tshogs gnyis mtsho// smon lam ri bos bsrubs skyes sprul sku'i zla// mthong na mngon dga'i bsil zer 'bum 'dzag pa// rgyal bstan dpal mgrin ral pa'i rgyan 'god phyir// zab gsang bstan pa'i snang byed rdzogs chen pa'i// zhabs zung 'khor los bkod pa'i chos kyi khrir// 'phags bzhi so skye'i smra mkhas mgrin bsdebs pa'i// bkra shis kun gyi mnga' dbang bskur ba la// rigs lnga'i rgyal bas dbang bskur cho ga 'bogs// yid 'phrog dga' mas rdo rje'i glu dbyangs long*// rgyal sras rnams kyang shis brjod 'brug tu ldir// sems mas mchod 'bul khro tshogs bgegs mthar gyis// bsod nams byed pos bris pa'i dge legs mtshan// bkrag cher snang ba'i gzugs sku bskal pa'i bar// 'tsho gzhes brling bar bzhugs pa'i bcud len rdzas// tshe sbyin lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis sgrubs// thos nyung btung bas ma tshim drang srong ches// gtsug lag rigs pa'i gzhung gi dag byed rgyun// mtha' dag rnam dpyod gsus par bskyil ba'i mthus// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun mangs skyugs su chug /gzhung lugs rab 'byams dgongs don rgyan gsum gyi// lam nas thogs med 'dren pa'i rtsom 'chad dang*// brtsad mkhas mi zad ngag gi dngos grub de// 'jam dbyangs mtsho ldan dga' mas da ltar stsol// skyes sbyangs rnam par dpyod pa'i ded dpon bzang*// mtha' klas shes bya'i gzhung gi chu gter che// brgal byed thabs la mkhas pa'i grur zhugs nas// yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas nyid byin rlobs// grangs med sems can re ba'i yol go dag

/tha dad phyogs nas gdangs dgu chos tshul gyi// mngon 'dod de des bde blag 'gengs bzod pa'i// lung rtogs yon tan dpag bsam bskyed bsring mdzod// de skad smras don snye ma g.yur za ba'i// ngag gi mtshon rnon grub pa ma 'tshal yang*// skyabs gsum bden dpang gsol ba'i smon lam dag /gzhar yang snying pos dben par ma gyur cig /snying rje gzhan dbang gyur pas sprul pa'i sku'i// bgrod byed pad+mas mngon par bkod pa'i khri// dam pa'i chos kyis mtho bar gyur pa la// grangs med yid can spyi bos btud pa'i drung*// dal rten sdong bu rab ldem rtse mo na// rab dga'i 'dab brgya rnam par grol ba'i nang*// gtsug lag thos pa'i ge sar bzhad pa las// khri 'bul mtshon pa'i shis brjod rten bcas phul// deng 'dren mchog rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku'i yang srid rin po che/ chos kyi khrir mnga' gsol ba'i legs 'bul brda mtshon tsam du lha dar dkar pos mtshon pa'i bcu gsum tshan 'di zhu dag bla mas phul ba lags/ zhes pa tshul rin rang nyid kyis 'phral du sug bris bgyis pa'o// ༈ /rnam 'dren yongs kyi ye shes tshon// smon lam 'dri byed khams song bas// riṃn cheṃn gsum dngos rnam bkra'i sku// miṃ 'gyuṃr bstan pa'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn rgyal// thun mtshams lang tshor snang gter 'od// 'khyud par nye tshe'i mdzes sdug gis// dge mtshan sku yi ngo mtshar sgrun// ma bzod ngo mdangs gnag snyam byed// sgron ma'i skal bzang ji srid yun// rdzogs min de srid ri dwags dgras// bsgyings bteg chos kyi rkang stegs la// zhabs zung chu skyes bkod pa der// rtse gcig dad pa'i lag sor bcu// bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan mchog tu// mnyam sbyar ldem pa'i smra sgo las// tshogs gsum spel ba'i dbyangs chung 'bul// bgrang yas skye ba'i tshogs mtsho las// legs 'khrungs gsang gsum rgyan gyi zla// thub bstan dpal mgrin ral rtse nas// phan bde'i bsil zer 'dzag pa can// gang gi mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od kyis// nyer bkrus skyabs kyi 'og rol pa'i// bsti gnas sngon med mchod rten du// bskrun pa'i skal ba sbom po'i drin// rus sbal 'jug pas bteg nus min// lha rdzing 'dom pas 'jal dka' dag

/bdag cag legs byas tshong zong gis// cha shas 'tshob 'dod gad mo'i rgyu// 'on te skal ba'i yol go'i nang*// srid 'byor ka ca spungs gang las// dngos 'byor dbyig gi maṇ+ḍal 'di// dad dga' brtas pa'i lag pas stob// de'ang skyabs gcig mchog gi gzugs sku'i yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ phran cag gi grwa khang du phebs thub pa'i sku drin cha shas gsob mtshon du lha dar dkar po sogs bcu bdun tshan 'di gnyer pa tshul khrims dbang phyug gis gus par phul/ zhes pa'ang don du gnyer ba po'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// ༈ /gang zhig skyabs su bsten tsam gyis// srid zhi'i mi mthun 'jigs tshogs las// skyob byed thugs rje'i phyag rkyong ba// dkon mchog gsum dngos 'dren pa rgyal// mu med zhing gi rnam 'dren gyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan tshogs// mdo sngags bstan pa smra mchog gi /sgyu 'phrul zlos pa gang gi sku// mi shigs rdo rje gsum gyi khams// bskal par brtan pa'i cho ga mkhan// bsnyegs bral bzhi ldan seng ge'i khri// lhar bcas skye dgus btud pa der// chos las skyes pa'i bka' 'bangs bdag /dad gus thal sbyar me tog dag /yan lag mchog la rnam bkod pa'i// gsol ba gdab bya'i snying por dgongs// da lam kho bo cag gi tsha bo dge slong kun dga' rgya mtsho ba 'tsho ba'i dus las yol te snga lam du chas pa de lta na'ang*/ deng dus 'di phyi'i skyabs mchog bslu med thugs rje'i bdag nyid can nyid/ gyi na pa'i bsti gnas su skye 'gro'i gtsug na ngal gsor spyod par 'os pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mas mngon par bcags pa dang chab cig dmigs yul ltos bcas 'khor ba dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las bskyab phyir bcom ldan thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por bcug ste/ dbang bskur phyir bzlog gi cho gas mtshon/ rnam dkar dge rtsa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por smin pa'i yongs bsngo dam pa'i thugs brtses bskyangs pa'i sku drin gyi cha shas gsob mtshon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul brdar/

dar kha sogs bcas rnam grangs nyer gcig 'di dag bka' 'bangs tshul khrims rab brtan can gyis gus par phul ba lags/ zhes pa 'di'ang ban+de tshul rin gyis so// ༈ /rnam 'dren ma lus bskyed pa'i yab// 'gro blo'i ma rig mun sel lha// 'jam dpal ngur smrig 'chang zol gyis// bstan pa'i snang byed rgyal gyur cig /lha mi ltos 'phye'i dbang po sogs// che dgu'i spyi bos bsten byas kyang*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung gis nyen pa'i// rmongs chen sems can bran brtson pa// gang gi zhabs kyi mtsho skyes zung*// skye dgu'i bla na bskal pa brgyar// byin rlabs phan bde'i 'od rdul can// brtan byed chos kyi khri dam par// 'di nas bla med byang chub bar// skyabs gsol tshig gi bzlas brjod pas// thal sbyar ban+dhu dzī ba ka /gtsug tu bkod pas 'di skad gleng*// deng skyabs mchog mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can gyi gzugs sku'i nyin mor byed pa gang de/ bdag cag gi sdum par spyan 'dren gyi zhu ham bgyis par/ byin rlabs phan bde'i gzi brgya 'phro bzhin phebs pa'i thugs rje dang lhan cig phran chung spun gyi dal rten bskyed pa'i drin chen gyi pha rgan lhog ris can dang*/ khu bo rgan po sangs rgyas 'byung gnas zung dag 'tsho ba'i dus bgyis par rjes gzung gi cho ga dbang bskur byang sreg bcas pa'i sku drin gyis bskyangs pa'i dga' spro gal te gzugs su bgyir btub na srid pas theg dka'i rang bzhin du gyur kyang*/ bdog pas dben pa'i mos 'dun chen po byas par dgongs khrel mi 'jug par gsol ba 'debs mtshon tsam du lha dar dkar po sogs rnams gus ldan sangs rgyas bzang po spyan gyis brgya phrag brtsegs pa'i phyag dang bcas te phul ba lags so// zhes pa 'di'ang tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༈ /swa sti bi dza ya tu/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od rdul zegs mas lhung ba'i mod// srid zhi'i dge legs phun tshogs 'dab ma brgya ldan tshal// kun nas 'dzum dkar bsu ba thugs rje'i snang ba'i gter// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir shis pa'i me tog stsol// phyogs bcu'i rnam par 'dren pa'i me zhal ji snyed kyi// yon tan sa bon gcig gyur 'dren mchog thig le'i dpyid// bde gshegs bstan pa'i smra dbang rig byed 'byin po yi// brtan pa rang dbang phrogs pa'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen// ltos 'phye nor rgyas ngal ba'i sdug bsngal ma byin zhing*// sa 'dzin dbang po bsgril ba'i thub chod brtsams pa med// nyal 'gro'i phung po ma bsrubs par yang skyabs mchog gi

/snang ba'i gter nyid nyer thob 'gro 'di skal ba bzang*// nam mkha'i rna ba gcig las tha dad dag byed snod// de snyed rang gzugs ma 'gags ston ltar rgyal kun gyi// 'gro ba 'dul byed thabs la mkhas pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// gzhar yang 'gog med rnam 'phrul bkod pa ci yang ston// pir rtses ma bris lhun gyis grub pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku// ma bteg skye dgu'i bla ma nyid du mngon par mtho// ma bskul na yang 'gro la phan par 'doms pa khyod// 'dris min 'gro ba yongs kyi mdza' bshes mchog tu khums// skyes sbyangs rtsal gyis legs phye longs spyod 'khor lo las// mdo rgyud shes bya'i gzhung gis brjod bya gang dang gang*// skyon bral snyan dngags dam pa las 'phos glu len tshe// mtsho byung dgyes pas mgrin par lhags te blta min nam// snying rjes shin tu mnyen par byas pa gang gi thugs// ris bral yid can kun gyi mnyes gshin dam pa yang*// mi shes rmongs pa rtsad nas gcod la s+t+wa re'i dbal// mi bzad rno ba'i reg bya 'dzin pa 'di ni ci// dpal stug ring lugs skyong dang spel ba'i phrin las mtha'// 'od srungs byin gyi bzhin ras kun du brdal ba 'dis// khyab 'jug gnam gnon 'jug pas sa gsum bcal ba'i gtam// gzhan 'drid g.yo sgyus rnam par bslad pas chos la gnod// ris bdun sdom pa'i bslab bya ston pa'i zil dngar gyis// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung bro rigs mi bzad pa// nyer bcil mya ngan 'das pa'i zhi bsil bde ba la// legs sbyor chos 'dul smra ba'i sman pa bla na med// 'gro tshogs srid las gdon pa'i g.yar dam thugs kar bcas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub smon dang 'jug pa'i them skas brten// lus can mtha' dag rgyal ba'i myu gu'i go sa ru// bde bar 'khrid pa'i rnam grol lam ston khyod 'dra su// gsang chen rgyud sde'i chu bdag ma dros grong khyer las// dbang bskur dag byed rgyun bzhi legs par blangs nas ni// skal ba ches sbom gdul bya sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i// lam dang 'bras bur sbyor ba'i dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// des mtshon phyi nang gsang ba'i yon tan che ba'i cha// tshogs gsum lam nas smreng ba'i rigs su son 'gyur gyi// dogs pa'i yi ge snying la shar ba'i khrung khrung 'joms// gtam gyi 'bab stegs rnam pa drug tu sprul lam snyam// mkhyen dang brtse nus lang tsho dar bab mdza' na bos// dge legs gsar pa'i yid 'phrog sgeg mo khengs ldan dag

/'jig rten khams kyi sdum par bkug nas srid dang zhi'i// bde 'byor phun tshogs dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i byed po gang*// bskal par brtan byed legs bris lag 'gro mi yul gyi// sna tshogs nor bu'i phra tshom bkod legs seng ge'i khri// dad gsum khur gyis rab lci skye 'gro'i yan lag mchog /'od srungs byin la ngal gsor spyod snyam btud pa der// 'dren mchog thugs rje'i dpag bsam rgyas pa'i grib bsil du// bde bar ngal gso rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i legs gsungs kyi// bdud rtsi'i skal ba nod pa'i dge sbyong theg pa che'i// ring lugs skyong ba'i khur len bgyis pa'i gyi na pas// char ldan dus kyi mkha' glang 'khrigs par gtsug phud can// dga' ba'i dbyangs 'byin spu sdug ngom pa'i gar bsgyur ltar// dad dang dga' ba lhan cig rgyas pa'i smra sgo nas// skabs su bab pa'i mi 'gyur phreng bsgrigs 'di skad gsol// zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba'i tshigs su bcad pa nyung shas kyis ngag don yod par bgyis nas/ ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i me long du rnam par bkra ltar kho bo cag las byed kyi khur len bzhag nas zos dal du gnas par blo gtad kyin mchis skabs/ sde dger mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po pa nyid thugs rje dang 'gro don gyi phrin las rgyas pa sogs khyad par 'phags par bzhugs pa de lta na'ang bstan 'gro'i gegs chag rnam par bdo bas gzugs sku zhi dbyings su brtul bar brten/ mdo khams ljongs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge sa skyong bla ma khu dbon bcas nas nged rang mchod gnas su btang dgos par gzhung sa chen po gdan sa gong mar bcas la nan tan gyis snyan sgron phul ltar de dag nas kyang bka' stsal phebs nas mdo khams su mi bteg dbang bral ltar byung song ba de lta na'ang*/ skyabs mchog mtshungs zlas dben pa 'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po lta bu rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi 'od rdul rgyun mi chad pas legs par bsrungs pas/

lam bar kun du nye zho'i rigs kyis rnam par ma bslad par bde bar son cing*/ der bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sku 'khor du bcas pa rnams dang mjal 'dzom legs pa byung ba/ de nyid nas brtsams te der 'khod kyi dgon sde mnga' 'bangs bcas pa thams cad nas bkur gzos gzabs shing*/ dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag gson gshin du gtogs pa'i 'gro ba mang po'i phyogs nas byung ba'i dkor rdzas rnams chud mi 'dza' ba dang rang gzhan gyi rgyud du dge tshogs rnam par spel ba'i 'dun sems smon gsum gyi sgo nas/ gtsang dbus phyogs kyi dbyig 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor kun du 'khod pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis mtshon pa'i dgon sde rnams kyi bla ma mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i rigs la mchod 'bul dang mang ja'i bsnyen bkur nyung shas stob par mi mngag 'di dag btang ba'i gnas tshul cung zad lags shing*/ khyad par lhar bcas skye dgu'i skyabs gcig mtshungs zla med pa'i gtsug gi nor bu rin po che/ 'jig rten khams su bde legs shis pa'i sgo 'phar bye ba brgya phrag cig car du 'byed pa'i gser gyi mngal can/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi phung pos mngon par 'byor ba'i gang zag kun gyis bla nas bla mar mchod cing bkur ba/ 'gro ba mtha' dag srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las gdon pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i ded dpon chen po/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lugs bzang 'jig rten khams su 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las kyi sgo du ma nas ring 'tshor bgyid pa'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nyid kyi sku zhabs su mchod 'bul maṇ+ḍal gyi brda mtshon du/ bkra shis pa'i rtags kyis spras pa'i lha dar dkar po srid du ring ba sogs/ bcas 'di dag rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa dbang thang gi khams dang mthun pa'i ming la chu lug ces pa'i bgrang gzhi shar bar/

snyom las pas bod chen por grags pa'i ljongs kyi thig le lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling nas gus par phul bar rnam pa thams cad du tshad med thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras kyis gzigs pas nam yang mi bor bar gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi ba lags so// zhes pa gtsang paṇa chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i sku zhabs su 'bul tshan gyi gong brjod snyan dngags chu gter g.yo ba'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// yo3dh+yeṣaṇāk+ṣarabiwar+t+tanabaṃshamātraiḥ lak+ṣ+mīshubhaṃbhabashamaustaruṇas+yamitraḥ rat+natribhirlayanaman+t+ritakābhikāmā/ d+yātraṃshiṣobidzayapuṣ+paṃprayats+tshamehi//
