brjod me tog stsol la spyon// mkha' dang mnyam par ring song shes bya ji snyed gzhung*// dpyad gsum dag par smra ba'i rgyal por sangs rgyas dang*// de sras mkhas pa bye ba'i snyan dngags dam pa yis// kun nas rab bsngags sa skya'i rje btsun rim byon dang*// de tshul 'jig rten ches cher snang byed mkhas pa'i mchog /grangs med rgyu skar khrod kyi bdud rtsi'i 'od can ltar// lhang nger 'phags pa rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang*// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i rtogs brjod bsams kyin dad// sangs rgyas dgongs don 'chad par ngag gi dbaṃng phyug grub// gzhung lugs rab 'byams mgrin las 'jo ba kunaṃ dgaṃ'i dpal// bloṃ groṃs 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i do zlar bstanaṃ rigs paṃ'i// 'dzam bu ljon pa'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn can 'di mdzes pa'i rgyan// thub dbang yon tan phung po gdung 'tshob bcas pa'i thugs// rdul bral ye shes sa bon las skyes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mkhyen dpyod brtse nus phun tshogs yid 'phrog lang tsho yis// dran dbang snying gi rig byed 'byin po'i brtan pa dbrog /brgya phrag bsod nams rgan las thos pa'i smyu gu'i rtses// bkra shis dge mtshan bzang po'i gzugs brnyan bkrag po cher// legs par bris pa'i skyabs mchog nam mkha'i rna ba des// rgyal bstan mi zhal lam yangs mdzes par lham mer spud// ci 'dod gsol btab snye ma de des 'gengs pa'i mchog /skyabs su thob pa'i dga' ba rgya chen 'di ni slar// sku gsum gsang ba gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje ltar// brtan byed cho ga grub las thob kyi gzhan du ci// nyams dang 'gyur khugs mi zad rna bar 'jebs pa'i dbyangs// yid 'phrog dri za'i tam+bu ra las 'phos 'dra yang*// phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung gis brjod bya cang ston pas// 'dren pa mchog gis legs bshad nyid du yong ye khums// mtha' klas chos kun longs spyod 'khor lo grol ba las// rgyun chags 'khor yug 'doms pa'i tshul la mtshar ci che// gang 'di shes bya ma lus sprul dang 'chad byed pa'i// 'jam dpal rdo rje mi yi srid pa bzung tsam nyid// gang blos rnam par dpyad pa'i g.yar lam ga la bar// srid pa mya ngan las 'das mkhas pa'i mchog rnams kyis// 'chos skyob gzhung lugs bskal pa'i phreng bar sprul na yang*// zab brling khengs pas bsgyings pa'i shes bya mi srid snyam// snang srid gzugs brnyan 'gog med kun mthong dri med 'dis// lkog gyur shes bya'i rang bzhin ston pa'i mthu rdzogs na// gzhal bya gnas gsum yul la dpyod pa'i lung rigs dang*// gdams pa tshad ma'i 'byung gnas gang blo'i grogs por byed// mngon 'dod yi ge snying la rnam bkod don gnyer gyi// gdul bya'i re ba bde blag 'gengs pa khyod kyi zhal// thang re mthong tsam smra mkhas grags pa gzhan gyi zhabs// spyi bos blang phyir gus pa lhod 'gyur 'di ci ga

/dpal gyi mgur las dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum gyi// 'gro khams 'tsham par chos kun 'doms la mi bsngags te// 'chad rtsom brtsad pas bstan skyong mkhas pa mchog rnams kyis// tshul 'di las gzhan bsgrub bya 'ga' yang srid min phyir// khor yug yangs par yid srubs rgyun lugs chad 'di ko /zla snang ma yin phrin las 'khor los bsrungs pa'i shugs// phyogs rnams kun nas chos spyod rnam bcu lhur len pa// lag gi bla min spyod rjes sgrub pa'i rjes 'jug go /sgrib gnyis bcud dang bral ba spun dag mkhyen dpyod kyi// gsus par bcil ba'i rtogs brjod mchid du gleng ba yi// snyan dngags rgyan gyi chu klung bye ba btungs pas kyang*// tshim mtha' med pa'i rnam 'dren mtshungs med ma har+ṣi// gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi che ba'i cha shas re// yid la rnam bkod chub par ma bzod ngal ba'i lus// lan brgyar dub pa sa la ngal gso lha phyag gi /zol gyis bsgribs la sprul pa'i lus brgyas gad mor dgod// rang bzhin bcas pa'i kha na ma tho'i g.ya' yi dris// sems rgyud me long mog por btang bar rnam mkhyen gyi// sa lam yon tan gzugs snang 'gog byed sdig ltung dri// stobs bzhi'i bshags pa'i 'dag chal gyis sbyangs tshangs par stsol// kha ba'i rdul brtsegs sa 'dzin dbang por kun phan gyi// snang bas 'khyud pa'i dkar mdzes mtha' dag byed po yis// phyogs gcig spungs las 'phos ltar dug gsum med pa'i blos// mngon par 'du byas 'gro ba'i dge bar rjes yi rang*// kun rmongs kun 'khrugs kun dkris 'ching zhags dam po yis// 'gro drug sems kyi rir skyes gzhon nu bcings pa rnams// bdag med rtogs pa'i ral gris yongs dral rnam grol nags// rtse 'jor rol pa de srid khyod zhabs brtan par bzhugs// mkhas tshul dri med gsum gyis zab dang rgya che'i chos// mtha' yas gdul bya dbang po rno rtul bar ma yi// skal ba ji bzhin bden gnyis zung 'jug chos kyi dbyangs// snyan dgu rtag par 'byin pa'i gsol 'debs gling bu bsgyur// tshul 'dis nyer mtshon dge ba thams cad rnam pa kun// gyi nar go la'i lam du mi rgyu nyin mtshan gyi// 'dab brgya'i tshal dag 'byed 'dzum bya ba mi byed par// khams gsum 'gro 'dul smra ba'i nyi ma mchog phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten ldan sangs rgyas kyi// dgongs don 'dzin 'chad tshul la mkhas pa'i rjes su zhugs// thams cad mkhyen rgyu shes bya'i yul la blo gsal bas// chos dang 'gro la sman 'dogs sgrub pa nyid gyur cig

/mkhar nyal lag 'gro mi bdag bcas pa'i gtsug gis bsten// gsol btab snying po 'bad rtsol med par bde blag stsol// khor yug yangs par 'gengs pa'i 'od 'bar yid bzhin gyi// nor bu'i rgyal po nyer thob 'gro 'di skal ba bzang*// rigs drug sems can yongs su grol min de srid du// mgon khyod gsang gsum 'gyur med lhun po'i spun gyi zlar// rab brling byed par nor bu rin chen las bskrun pa'i// mi 'jigs bzhi mtshon gdong lnga'i khri 'phang ga la bar// rgyal gsung rin chen rjes su sgrub 'dun mi 'gyur brdar// bag yod rtags su ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang gi gzugs// brtse chen snying po'i tshul chen 'doms pa'i mchog khyod kyi// legs gsungs zil dngar thigs pas 'tsho ba'i slob 'bangs pa// lhas bskos dbyar gyi dpal mos bskyed bsrings dal rten shing*// gzhung lugs thos pa'i lo 'dab gzhon nu g.yo ba nas// phyogs der dad dga' rgyas pa'i zhu 'phrin 'gyur khugs glu// gzhan gsos bu mos skad gdangs snyan par 'di skad bsgyur// zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba 'di dag kyang dgos pa chung zhing spros pa'i lam du gom pa bkod pa'am/ shes rlom gyis mngon par rgyags pas kun nas bslangs te bgyis pa min pa'ang*/ 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni// snyan dngags mkhan tshe bde gshegs rtswa mchog la// tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang*// dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed do// zhes 'byung ba ltar yon tan gyi zhing mchog tu gyur pa'i che ba yid la bsams kyin mchod par brjod pa dang*/ dngos po nges bstan gyi tshigs su bcad pa nyung zad kyis ngag gi bya ba don yod par byas nas/ skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba 'bul ba/ deng dus stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ bye brag tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dgongs don ma nor bar gsal bar byed pa'i mkhyen rab dang tshad med thugs rje'i dbang phyug dad sgrol chen po brtse chen kun dga' snying po yab sras rim par byon pa'i ring lugs tshad ma gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i 'byung gnas dam pa nyid/

'jig rten gyi khams su rtag par brling zhing dar rgyas su byed pa'i phrin las nyi zla'i snang bas mu med phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'gengs par byed pa'i mnga' bdag rin chen ri'i rgyal po nyid kyi dgongs bzhed bsgrub pa'i 'dun sems kyi khur bu bcangs te bka'i slob 'bangs gyi na pa bdag mdo khams kyi ljongs 'dir bteg pa bde bar son zhing*/ der bstan pa'i sbyin bdag khu dbon sku 'khor du bcas pas mtshon/ chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i chos sde yul mir bcas nas bkur gzos gzabs shing*/ dad can sbyin bdag gson gshin gyi skye 'gro bgrang du med pa'i phyogs nas byin pa'i dkor rdzas kyi rigs nyung shas mchis pa rnams chud mi 'dza' bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ srid pa'i dpal 'byor snying pos dben pa las dge tshogs kyi snying po dam pa blang ba'i phyir/ lhar bcas skye dgu kun gyi skyabs mgon chen po/ dkon mchog gsum tshogs 'dus pa'i skyabs gcig dbang gi rgyal po/ srid mtshor byings pa'i 'gro ba gdon pa'i ded dpon mtshungs pa med pa/ yid srubs thul gyi dbang po'i phrin las rjes su skyong ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po/ mkhas grub rgyu skar phreng tshogs bkra ba lta bu'i dbus na kun phan gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal ba'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i mtshan gyi rnga chen srid pa'i khongs na lhang nger ldir ba rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag chen po nyid gtso bor smos pa'i gtsang dbus phyogs kyi dbyig 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i bstan pa'i snang byed du gyur pa'i mchod yul chen po'i rigs dang*/ gdan sa'i chos sde che chung bar ma'i rdo rje slob dpon mkhan slob dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs bcas gang dag bzhugs par tshogs bsags kyi mchod 'bul mang ja'i bsnyen bkur stob pa'i 'dun sems smon gsum gyi sgo nas mi mngag 'di pa brdzangs pa 'phros 'bul lags shing*/

'dir ji ltar gsol ba ltar/ gtan gyi skyabs gcig khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po nyid kyi tshad med mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gdung skyob dkar po'i grib mar rtag par chud pa'i sku drin gyi phung po mtha' tshad bskal pa mang por btsal yang cha shas re'ang 'tshob tu ga la srid mod/ legs gsol gyi maṇ+ḍal mchod 'bul brda mtshon du bkra shis pa'i re khās sgeg pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs/ bcas 'di dag bka'i slob 'bangs gyi na pas rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsel sna tshogs zhes pa dbang thang gi khams dang bstun pa'i ming du chu lug gi bgrang gzhir btags par/ mdo khams ljongs kyi nor gyi blo gros ma'i thig le/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi phan bde kun khyab gling nas gus pas phul bar ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan zur gyi 'bab stegs su stsal ba'i bka' drin dang*/ rtag tu thugs rje chen pos bsrungs pa'i rwa ba las mi bskyud brdar legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang gi spun zlar mi 'chad pa bskal pa bzang po'i yol gor stsal ba gsol ba 'debs kyin mchis pa lags so// dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po par 'bul rgyu'i zhu 'phrin gzhan gsos bu mo'i gdangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /swasti bi dza ya tu/ gang dag mtshan gyi mi 'gyur phreng ba'i glu// skal bzang sgra 'dzin gsos su lhung bas kyang*// srid zhi'i dge legs gzhon nu 'gugs byed pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis shis pa'i cho ga sgrubs// rnam 'dren yongs kyi yon tan nyal 'gro'i gter// smon lam sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa'i bcud// 'gro ba'i bsam rdzogs thugs rje'i bsil zer can// chu skyes phyag gi zla gzhon gtsug na rgyal// deng dus sems can sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi /gdung bas dngos dang brgyud nas nyen pa las// skyob par nges pa'i skyabs zhig yid byas tshe// mgon khyod brnyes pa'i skal ba ches cher sbom// gdul dka' snyigs mar 'phyan pa'i lus can rnams// 'dul byed skyabs kyi dam pa gtsug thob pa'i// rab dga'i dpal 'di slad du'ang 'dren pa mchog

/bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes las gzhan gang gis thob// skad cig sangs rgyas sa gnon stobs rdzogs kyang*// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam rjes chags gzugs// mtha' yas gdul bya'i blor 'tsham sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba byang chub 'khrid pa'i yang srid bzung*// skye ba'i sgrib pas ma nongs mkhyen klong du// shes bya'i dngos kun ma 'dres gsal 'char na// mthong ba'i chos 'dir phyi nang gtsug lag gzhung*// bslab sbyangs rtun pa'i ngal ba ci slad bstan// 'on te thams cad mkhyen rgyu shes bya'i gnas// ji snyed nyams su bstar ba mkhas pa'i tshul// gdengs can bsti gnas chen pos dag byed rgyun// rtag tu btung yang ngoms pa nam zhig mthong*// bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum bslab bya'i gnas// ji snyed tshogs gsum lam nas 'doms bzod na// chab sgra yid 'ong 'byin 'bab mtho ris klung*// smra mkhas khyod kyi legs gsungs rjes su snyegs// rab 'byams gzhung lugs bzhed pa tha dad tshul// lam srol zung dang sgra don gab tshig rgyan// gang las blangs kyang 'dzad med ngag gi dpal// mtsho ldan ma las ma byin blangs pa dogs// mkhyen dpyod rin chen rtsig pa'i me long du// bden gnyis shes bya'i gzugs brgya snang ba'i bzhin// khyad par dpyod nus añja na bu yi// rig pa'i lta byed min pa su zhig rtogs// skye dgu'i re ba 'gengs khyod yon tan gyi// do zla bdag la yod snyam yid bzhin nor// rgyags pa mi 'tshal lus med thul gyi mchog /grub pa kun la tshul de yod phyir ro// mkhas tshul gsum gyi las dang ma zlum gyi// snang ba chen pos 'od srungs byin gyi mthar// nyul bar mtshungs kyang rgyal ba'i phrin las rgyun// rjes su skyong bas khyod kyi mdzad par khums// mngon shes grub brdzus mos gus ma phrogs shing*// kha gsags gzhan gyi rnam thar bcos mas kyang*// bsgyur ba ma bzod 'phags pa'i sgyu 'phrul la// mi phyed dad pa'i ba spu kun nas g.yos// bsngags yul skye ba phal pa'i rnam 'phrul min// rjod byed ngag tshig ngal ba don chung min// gang phyir daṇ+ḍī'i gzhung las 'phos pa'i ngag

/rgyas min mchod pa 'bul la spro ba brtas// phyogs bral smra mkhas bye ba'i snyan dngags kyi// nyal 'gro ji snyed btung yang ngoms min pa'i// skyabs mchog a gas+t+ya nyid che ba'i shas// 'phrin yig snying gar bkod pa'i thal sbyar btud// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'dod pa dgur// dbang 'byor mchog la dgos pa phra gyur mod// bdag dang ltos bcas dngos po don yod phyir// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa mtshar du dngar// mu med 'khor ba'i thang du dug gsum gyi// chang myos sdig ltung gom pa gang 'phyan pa// dkon mchog gsum 'dus bla ma'i g.yar lam du// stobs bzhi rdzogs pa'i cho gas mthol zhing bshags// srid dang srid pa las 'phags 'gro tshogs kyis// dus gsum mngon par 'du bgyis legs byas ni// kha ba kun+da dung gi rjes 'gro la// yi rang zla 'od lta bus ches dkar bgyi// srid gsum 'gro ba'i sems kyi gnyis 'thung dag /dug gsum rnyog ma'i 'dam du 'khyams so cog /theg gsum bslab bya gang 'tsham lcags kyu yis// rigs gsum byang chub lam du bkri bar bskul// brgya phrag bsod nams gser mngal pir gyi rtses// dge mtshan ri mo bkrag cher bris pa'i sku// duḥkha de rgyur bcas pa'i srid pa yi// pha rol ma mthong de srid bzhugs gsol 'debs// yongs su bsngo'o 'dir 'bad rnam dkar dge /dus gsum skye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams kyang*// gcig tu nyer bsdoms bla med byang chub rgyur// 'khor gsum sgyu ma'i rtse 'jor shes pas so// mdog bzang rdul brtsegs lhun por mi sbyin skyes// 'od stong 'bar bas 'khyud pa'i gzi brjid la// co 'drir bzod pa'i dge mtshan lham me ba// mthong don snying pos rab lci gzugs kyi sku// mi 'gyur bskal par brling phyir lha dang mi'i// nor bu rin chen las bskrun gdong lnga'i khri// grangs med yid can yan lag mchog btud pa'i// gzugs brnyan rnam bkra'i me long gang yin der// bu ram shing pa'i zhal lung nyal 'gro'i rgyun// ji snyed mkhyen dpyod lto bar rab song yang*// legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan 'bum skyugs pa'i// bdud rtsi'i zegs ma nod pa'i brtul zhugs pas// mchog sprul chen po'i nyi gzhon mthong ba la// dad dga' rgyas pa'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// 'dzum par dmul ba'i khrod nas skabs don gyi// 'phrin yig bung ba'i dbyangs chung 'di skad gsol// zhes yul mchog tu gyur pa'i yon tan las nye bar brtsams pa'i mchod brjod dngos po nges bstan gyi snyan dngags kyi phreng ba nyung shas kyis ngag don yod par bgyis nas/

shes bya'i gnas kun sgrib bral du gzigs pa'i me long du rnam par gsal ba ltar/ kho bo cag bstan pa'i las 'gan gyi khur 'degs lo shas bgyis nas zos dal du gnas par dgongs grol byung nas bsdad skabs/ sde dger mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po pa nyid byon nas phrin las dang 'gro don rgyas pa sogs khyad par 'phags par bzhugs pa'i skabs der bstan 'gro'i gegs chag bzlog tu med par che bas gzugs sku zhi dbyings su brtul bar brten/ mdo khams ljongs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge sa skyong bla ma khu dbon bcas nas/ nged rang mchod gnas su btang dgos par gru 'dzin mgon po'i bsti gnas 'dir rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku rin po che rtse shod du nan gyis snyan sgron phul bar/ kho bos mdo khams su 'gro dgos par bka' lung rin chen gser gyi cod paṇa spyi bor bcings par bcas mi bteg dbang bral lta bur byung song ba de lta na'ang*/ bslu med skyabs mchog mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi srung 'khor rdo rje'i rwa bar chud pas/ bshul ring bgrod dka'i lam bar kun du gegs dang nye zho'i rigs kyis ma gtses par dmigs pa'i yul der bde bar son zhing*/ der bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sku 'khor du bcas pa dang mjal 'dzom dge lam che ba byung zhing*/ de nas brtsams te der 'khod kyi dgon sde chab 'bangs bcas pa thams cad nas bkur gzos gzabs shing*/ dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag gson gshin tu gtogs pa'i 'gro ba mang po'i phyogs nas byung ba'i dkor rdzas nyung zad mchis pa rnams chud mi 'dza' ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud du dge ba spel ba'i 'dun pas/ gangs can ljongs kyi nor 'dzin lto ba dbus gtsang phyogs kyi dbyig 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor brten par bcas pa'i rnam 'dren bstan pa'i snang byed skyes mchog chen po rnams kyis nye bar mtshon pa'i dgon sde rnams kyi bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mkhan slob dge 'dun 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa'i rigs la mchod 'bul dang mang ja'i bsnyen bkur stob par mi mngag 'di rnams btang ba'i gnas tshul cung zad lags shing*/

khyad par deng 'dir legs bris dbang po dang*/ gan+dharba dang*/ sngon gyi lha dang gdengs can pa dang*/ mi'i dbang phyug rnams kyis mtshon pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi thor tshugs rtse mor nor bu rin po che ltar bkur ba/ 'jig rten khams su dge legs rdzogs ldan dus kyi skal bzang gzhon nu mgron du gnyer ba'i dang po pho nya lta bu/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa'i dug can gyi gnas su byings pa'i 'gro ba gdon pa'i thugs rje'i gru chen bskyod pa'i ded dpon chen po lta bu/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par gtams pa kun gyis bla nas bla mar bkur ba'i skyabs kyi yang rtser gyur pa/ dge legs kun gyi gzhir gyur lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa mkhas tshul gsum gyi sgo nas gsal bar byed pa'i ring lugs smra ba'i nyin mor byed pa/ bsil ldan ljongs kyi mgon po 'phags pa phyag na puṇ+ḍa rī kas mtshan pa'i sgyu 'phrul rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa rim par byon pa'i sku'i yang srid mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dam pa nyid/ deng gru 'dzin mgon pos byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i bsti gnas gang der/ ston mchog shākya seng ge ltar mi 'jigs bzhi ldan mtshon pa'i gdong lngas mdzes pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang ga la bar/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar rtag par shis pa'i cho ga kun gyis mnga' gsol ba'i legs 'bul brda mtshon dang*/ gus zhabs pa bdag kyang ljongs 'dir bde bar son pa'i legs gsol dang dkor rdzas kyi dngos po snying pos dben pa las kyang mchog gi snying po blang ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal mchod 'bul stob pa'i brda mtshon du/ bkra shis re khās sgeg pa'i lha dar dkar po srid du ring ba sogs/ bcas 'di dag rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi mar grags pa'i bgrang gzhi'i rgyu skar gyi bu mo sa gas nya yongs su gang ba'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes dge bar/

dge sbyong gyi na pas/ bod chen por grags pa'i ljongs kyi thig le lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling nas gus par phul bar/ rnam pa thams cad du tshad med thugs rje'i gdugs dkar g.yo ba'i khongs las gzhar yang mi bskyud par gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi ba lags so// zhes rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid sprul pa'i skur 'bul tshan gyi snyan dngags dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /swasti bi dza ya tu/ gar zhig dad pas skyabs su song ba'i 'phral// mthun min phyogs las rnam rgyal srid zhi'i dpal// ci 'dod lhun grub stsol ba dkon mchog gsum// 'dren mchog rtag par shis pa'i cho ga sgrubs// kha ba ri pa'i lha gcig chu skyes phyag /gzhan don sgyu ma'i rol rtsed thams cad mkhyen// skyabs mgon mchog gi bstan srid zung 'jug gi /khur chen skyong ba'i rgyal tshab sems dpa' che// che mchog rnams kyi thugs bskyed smon lam mthus// srid par gang 'dul sprul sku'i skye ba ston// nam mkha'i rna ba gcig las gtsang byed snod// ji snyed rang gzugs 'gog pa med pas mtshon// dpal stug de sras bcas pa'i ye shes kyi// lag pa stong phrag zlos pa'i gar bsgyur te// ngur smrig 'chang skur bris pa'i dge legs mtshan// rnam bkra bstan pa'i dpal du gyur drin che// gzhal bya mngon lkog shin tu lkog na mor// mjal byed rigs lung gdams pa tshad ma yis// 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i legs bshad 'bum 'jo bas// blo ldan snying gi brtan pa rang dbang phrogs// zab yangs rig pa'i gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnas// bskyungs pa med par mkhyen pa'i klong gcig tu// rdzogs par ma chud med pa'i thub chod 'dis// mtha' bral shes bya'i grags pa bstungs pa snyam// ris bral sems can re ba yongs 'gengs pa'i// ci 'dod rtag 'jo nor bu kostu bha// thar pa thams cad mkhyen lam 'doms pa'i mthus// spangs pa'i ngo tshas rnam rgyal khang par bros// byang chub spyod pa'i mdzad bzang skye dgu'i blar// mngon par rgyu ba'i 'og rol yid can tshogs// 'tshe byed ngal gsor bstan de dpag bsam du// rnam brtag grib bsil bsnyen la rgyug pas brel// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thugs bskyed dpag yas nyid// mtsho ldan lus phra dgyes pa'i 'phrin shod la// dpyod ldan bye bas bkrabs kyang rgyal ba'i sras// chen po'i rtogs brjod gcig tu 'dres pas ngal// deng 'dir phan bde kun gzhi lung rtogs kyi// chos dang sems can sman 'dogs lhan cig nyid// legs par bskyangs pa'i ngo mtshar mkhas pa'i tshul// rnam gsum dbang 'byor phan bde'i rtsa lag nyid// ma pham rgyal bas legs gsungs nyin mor byed// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bla mar byin rlabs kyi// 'od stong 'bar ba ma gyur de srid du// brtan byed zhabs stegs dam pa gang yin der// shākya'i sras kyi spyod rjes slob 'dun gyi// rkang pa'i gom pa bslab par 'os pa'i lam// rnam par bkod pa'i ngur smrig brtul zhugs can// mkhas pa'i rigs su skyes pa'i dge sbyong pa// legs mdzad rnam dkar brtas pa'i phyogs de na// yid dbang drangs la rab dga'i snyan dngags dbyangs// bsung ldan chu skyes mthong ba'i bh+ra ma ra'i// mgrin snyan glu yis rtsen bzhin 'di skad gsol// deng 'dir skabs su babs pa'i zhu gsol snying po/

zab yangs dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor legs par sim ltar/ ji ltar mchog sprul rin po che nyid rtse shod nas bka' lung phebs ltar/ kho bo cag mdo khams phyogs 'dir bteg pa gegs bral du son cing*/ der sa skyong bla ma khu dbon sku 'khor chab 'bangs bcas pa thams cad nas bkur gzos gzabs par stsal/ dad can sbyin bdag gson gshin gyi 'gro ba mang po'i phyogs nas byung ba'i dkor rdzas nyung shas mchis pa rnams 'di lor chud mi 'dza' bar/ bstan pa'i snang byed chen po rnams kyis mtshon pa'i chos sde phal cher gyi bla ma 'dus tshogs bcas la mang ja bsnyen bkur ched du btang 'dun gyis mi mngag 'di pa btang ba lags shing*/ da lam bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog sprul dam pa nyid thams cad gzigs pa gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab bstan pa'i khur chen skyong ba'i sku drin legs 'bul brda mtshon lha dar dkar po shis pa'i rtags can sogs bcas 'di dag gyi na pas phul bar brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis 'bab pa'i bka' drin dang*/ 'di par snga mkhor gang ci'i phyogs nas mgo 'dren bka' khyab mi dman pa nas rtag tu thugs brtse'i gzigs pa yangs pa'i khor yug las mi bskyud pa'i legs gsungs lha'i zil dngar gyi dga' ston lta bu yang rgyun chags su stsal bar gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi ba lags so// zhes rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal tshab de mo sprul pa'i sku rin po che la dbul rgyu'i yi ge bh+ra ma ra'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang don du gnyer ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa swasti bi dza yan+tu// ༈ /rmad byung byin rlabs yid 'phrog 'gram chang gis// nges par bran 'phral blo gros ba ku la// srid zhi'i dge legs 'dab brgya 'dzum bsu ba// dkon mchog gsum gyis rtag par khyed la srungs// kun mkhyen nyi ma'i rtsa lags bstan pa gang*// mkhas par 'os pa'i legs mdzad rnam gsum gyis// 'dziṃn skyong spel ba'i byed por ston mchog gi

/sgyu 'phrul dge mtshan lhunaṃ grubaṃ sprul pa'i sku// gcig tu dpag yas legs byas rma med kyi// sa bon gyis bskyed gzugs sku'i rkang 'thung dbang*// bkra shis mtshan bzang me tog ches bkra ba// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i grib bsil yol med skyabs// bzo gso'i rig gzhung thos pas bsod nams dang*// ring 'tshos dben pa'i 'gro ba rjes 'dzin yang*// sgra tshad gzhung lugs thos pas tshig don cha// log brtags gzhung ngan smra ba tshar gcod byed// bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung gis brjod bya yongs// lho shar srol dang rgyan gsum lam 'phos pa'i// legs bshad mgrin las 'jo 'dis mkhas kun gyi// 'dzad med ngag gi dngos grub brkus par dogs// pha rol gyis dben ji snyed shes bya'i yul// mkhyen rab klong yangs bkrag cher 'char nyid la// ched du mi bsngags gang phyir thams cad mkhyen// gzigs pas ma khyab chos shig gang du mchis// srid par ltar snang 'byor pa'i bza' btung la// rnam sred mngon mthor 'jug pa'i 'od 'grib par// chos 'dul bslab pa phra rags 'od 'gyed pas// gtan bde'i lam bzang 'doms khyod srid pa'i mig /bde bar gshegs pa kun lam theg chen pa'i// 'jug sgo srol chen zung gis gdul bya rnams// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i lta sgom spyod pa'i tshul// smra mkhas 'jam dpal ma pham rjes su snyegs// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang bas gsang chen rgyud// mtha' yas gdul bya'i blor 'tsham ston bgyid na// mtha' drug tshul bzhis bcings pa'i rgyud kyi don// mkhas khrod yang dag 'chad la ya mtshan ci// rgyud chen rnam bzhis nyer bstan smin grol rgyun// sems can skal pa'i grangs snyed rgyun chags su// bshad pas 'dzad min bha gi ra tha'i klung*// bskal pa'i khor yug 'bab pas rjes su mtshon// ma 'dris 'gro la phan par 'doms pa'i chos// ma bteg srid gsum bla mar brling bya'i phyir// ma bskul rtsom 'chad brtsad pa'i phrin las kyis// ma brdal phyogs mthar nyul ba'i tshul la rang*// rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i// lugs mchog 'jig rten snang bar byed pa'i mthu// khyod la yongs su rdzogs zhes dpyod ldan tshogs// re ba'i snyim pa phyogs der brkyangs pa snyam// gzhan 'drid lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg mi ngom zhing*// yid srubs sgyu rtsal spyod pa skyong min yang*// mkhas tshul 'phrin yig rna bar 'jebs pa'i tshe// snying la kun dga'i dpal bskyed 'dren pa mchog

/chos smra mchog gi gsang gsum mda' lnga pa'i// rno mtshon stong gis mi phigs brgya byin gyi// rdo rje'i khams su sra brtan cho ga mkhan// rin chen chos kyi rkang stegs ga la bar// sgyu 'phrul sras kyi tshul bstan thams cad mkhyen// legs gsungs zil mngar thigs pas 'tsho ba'i gzugs// thabs shes ye shes mtshan bstan skyong ba'i khur// nyer blangs dam pa'i rigs skyes dge sbyong pas// dal 'byor rten gyi ku sha'i spyil bu la// 'phral 'tshe'i gnyis 'thung yul gzhan 'khyams pa'i skabs// bstan 'gror phan 'dogs 'dun sems smon gsum gyi// lhag bsam dge ba'i ka ba brling khul nas// yid 'phrog pad+ma'i mtsho la ngur pa mo// mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung zhing 'phur lding gis// rnam par rtsen bzhin phyogs der mngon dga' ba'i// rjod byed mgrin pa bteg pas 'di skad gsol// de'ang rnam 'dren bstan pa'i snang byed dam pa'i mkhyen rab kyi rgya mtshor sim pa ltar/ kho bo cag gdan sa gong gzhung sar bcas pa'i bka' lung gi bzhed bkod ltar mdo khams kyi ljongs su bteg pa der gegs bral du son cing*/ gang ci'i legs lam che ba dang 'tsho khams bde nas bstan 'gror sman 'dogs kyi lhag bsam mi bskyud par gnas tshul lags shing*/ 'di lor bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos nyer mtshon/ dad can gyi 'gro ba gson gshin rnams kyi phyogs nas byung ba'i dkor rdzas nyung shas mchis pa rnams/ gtsang dbus phyogs kyi char 'khod mchod yul rnams la mchod 'bul mang ja'i bsnyen bkur cung zad stob 'dun gyis mi mngag 'di pa brdzangs par nang lugs kyi 'phros 'bul lags shing*/ deng 'dir rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag pa'i ring lugs gsal bar byed pa'i smra ba'i nyin mor byed par gyur pa'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid gsang gsum gzhom bral rdo rje'i khams su 'tsho gzhes bzhugs pa'i legs gsol brda mtshon tsam du bkra shis re khās sgeg pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs nas/

bcas 'di dag shākya'i sras kyi spyod rjes bsgrub 'dun ma bskyungs tsam gyi snyom las pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa'i bgrang gzhir/ mdo khams ljongs kyi dbyig 'dzin ma'i thig le sde dge lhun grub steng gi phan bde gling bla brang nas phul ba'i zhu yig gi me tog bzhed par brtse ba'i spyan ras 'chi med bung ba gzhon nu'i 'bab stegs 'cha' ba'i bka' drin dang*/ thugs nyes mdza' ba'i snyan dngags dam pa'i legs bshad man+dā rwa ba'i phreng ba ltar rgyun chags su stsal ba'i bka' drin yang zhu yin mchi ba lags so// zhes rtse gdong sprul pa'i sku rin po che bstan 'dzin lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por 'bul rgyu'i snyan dngags ngur mo'i mgrin pa'i rdza rnga zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs chos// rgyal sras mkhas tshul gsum gyis skyong ba por// rgyal gsung dri med kyis bstan kun dga' bzang*// rgyal tshab bcas pas deng 'dir dge legs stsol// chos dbyings mu med spros pa'i zhing kun du// gshegs dang 'tsho gzhes thams cad mkhyen kun gyi// ye shes sgyu 'phrul rnam rtsen zlos pa'i gar// theg gsum bstan pa'i smra dbang rgyal gyur cig /sngon bsags legs byas grags pa'i mu khyud kyis// dge mtshan re khā bkod legs ri dwags rtags// bkrag cher bris pa'i sdom brtson bsil sbyin mkhan// bstan skyong mi lhung phreng khrod lham mer gsal// bden gnyis khyad par rnam 'byed tshogs gsum phreng*// tshar du dngar ba'i ngo mtshar legs bshad rgyun// lhug par 'jo bas dpal mgrin ral pa'i klung*// ngan 'gro'i sgrib sbyong 'bab pa'i grags par 'phya// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros kyis// dpyad ngor bcu phrag shes bya rig pa'i gzhung*// mtha' klas khengs pa de 'dis phrogs so zhes// dpyod ldan blo ni 'tshol phyir khyod drung rgyug

/sna tshogs gdul bya'i mos pa ci dang cir// theg gsum tshul chen de des 'gengs bzod par// ched du mi bsngags gang phyir rang rang gi /skal bas thob snyam nyid du len phyir ro// 'phags dang so skye'i blo ldan yongs dgyes pa'i// mkhas pa la 'os phrin las 'od srungs byin// dkyil 'khor pha rol nyul ba'i rtogs brjod tshul// yi ges mchid la me skyes blo yang rtul// gang phyir sems can bsam kun rdzogs byed pa// bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog gi gsang ba gsum// rin chen lhun po nor ldan brtan ma'i lus// zho 'thung rus pa'i mtshon bzhin gzhom bral phyir// gyad bus ma bteg chos kyi che bas mtho// mdza' bas bcings min ris bral skye bos btud// rgya skyegs khu bas ma byugs dmar ba'i zhabs// rnam par bkod pa'i chos khri gang yin der// skal bzang dpal stug bzhi pa sras bcas kyis// srid zhi'i bde dge ster phyir bstan pa'i chos// thigs pas snying gar sim pa'i dge sbyong ni// gzhan don byang chub smon lam lhur len pas// mkhas grub bye ba'i zhabs rdul gyis btab pas// phyogs kun thar pa'i grong mchog byin brlabs pa'i// dbus gyur 'chang gi chos grwar bzhugs khyod kyi// phyogs der mgrin pa brkyangs nas 'di skad gsol// deng 'dir mkhar nyal bcas pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi blo ldan bye ba'i snyan dngags puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i tshogs kyis mngon par mchod kyin bsngags pa'i yul dam pa/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por gyur pa'i mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon rig pa 'dzin pa'i ded dpon chen po nyid/ sku gsung thugs 'pho bral mi phyed rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin rlabs phan bde'i gzi brgya 'bar bzhin bzhugs pa dang*/ kho bo cag kyang skyabs gcig gdan sa gong ma gzhung sar bcas pa'i bka' lung gi bzhed bkod stsal ba dang*/

bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i mos 'dun gyi ngor/ mdo khams ljongs su bstan lar bsams kyin bteg par/ lam bar kun nas gegs med du son cing bde bar 'khod pa nas/ 'di lor sa skyong chen po khu dbon sku 'khor bcas pa'i bkur gzos gzabs pas mtshon/ chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i sbyin bdag gson gshin grangs med rnams kyi phyogs nas byung ba'i dkor rdzas nyung zad mchis pa rnams/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i phyogs su btang ba'i 'dun pas mi mngag 'di pa brdzangs brdar bgyis lags pa'i 'phros 'bul tsam dang*/ da lam 'dir lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i bstan pa rin po che mkhas par 'os pa'i phrin las gzhal du med pas skyong bar byed pa'i 'dren mchog chos kyi rje'i drung du/ mchod 'bul maṇ+ḍal gyi brda mtshon du bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs/ bcas pa'i tshan grangs 'di dag dpal ldan nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs dri med kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang des/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsel stod 'grel las nyi ma zhes pa/ dbang thang khams dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming du na dā+e e ḍa ste chu mo lug ces grags pa'i bgrang gzhir/ mdo khams ljongs kyi nor 'dzin ma'i thig le/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling nas phul bar thugs nyes khyab pa'i dgyes bzhes dang*/ gang ci'i bka' stsal phebs 'os kyi legs par bshad pa'i snyan dngags 'chi med man+dā rwa ba'i phreng ba ltar rgyun chags su stsol ba'i bka' drin yang zhu ba lags so// zhes pa e waṃ khri thogs pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog grags par phul bya'i snyan dngags tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa dge legs rgyas par gyur cig/ ༈ /swasti bi dza ya tu/ thams cad mkhyen kun bskrun pa'i yab gyur kyang*// bcu drug bgrang bya'i lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg tshul// dran pas mi shes rmongs pa drung 'byin mod// blo mchog bskyed pa 'jam dpal gzhon nus skyongs// lha mchog gang de ngur smrig 'chang gi zol// bsod nams bzang zhes lnga rig smra mchog gi

/rigs su byon pa'i mgon khyod rnam 'dren gyi// bstan pa'i dpal du rab brling ngo mtshar che// byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i smon lam mthus// theg gsum bstan pa 'dzin 'chad rnam rol gyis// snyigs mar 'phyan pa'i lus can rnam grol lam// smin grol bgyid pa'i mtshan nyid rdzogs par bskrun// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i 'jug sgo sdom pa gsum// yan lag bcas pa tshogs gsum lam nyid nas// gdul bya'i blor 'tsham 'doms pa'i ngo mtshar khur// rdzogs par theg pa'i 'od srungs byin 'di brling*// shes bya'i yul la dpyod pa'i blo gros nyid// sngon skyer sbyangs pa'i mthu gcig ma nges te// dus gsum gzigs pa kun gyi mkhyen pa'i rab// ji snyed ma byin blangs pa zhig tu khums// srid par nyes pa'i skyon bral pad+ma dkar// kun gyi mnyes gshin gyur pa rgyal ba'i sras// rgyud sde'i don gzigs smra mkhas rdo rje 'chang*// gnyis par grub pa'i 'phrin snyan sgra 'dzin dpyid// sngon rabs dam pa'i rtogs brjod rjes bsgrub phyir// mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan yar ldan nyid// ngo mtshar spyod par rtun pas bag med du// gyi nar 'phyan pa'i snying la bskul ma 'debs// lham mer gsal lo sgrol byed rnam bkra'i khrod// ri bong 'dzin pa rab rgyas bdud rtsi'i zer// lha mi'i mchod gnas bgrang yas 'dus pa'i dbus// rtsod 'chad rtsom mkhas khyod kyi grags pa'i dpal// sgrib zung rgyun lugs chad pa khyod kyi rgyud// chags bral dben pa'i gnas su rnam brtags pas// bcu phrag shes bya'i gzhu kun tshogs gsum gyi// rnam pas ma 'dres bkrag cher 'khod pa bzhin// gsang rgyud kun gyis bsngags brjod snyan dngags glu// ji snyed btung yang ngoms med gsang gsum gyi// gsus rdzing rnam par yangs 'di gdan gsum lhar// kun 'dus mchog gi slob dpon ma har+ṣiḥ// byed pos rgya skyegs tshos su btsos pa med// 'char ka'i nyi gzhon 'od las ma bton pa'i// bgrod byed zung gi zhabs sen dmar 'od kyis// mdzes byas chos kyi zhabs stegs ga la bar// rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i zhal lung zla ba'i zer// nyung zad btung pas blo gros kun mud 'dab// rnam dkar dge ba'i phyogs su 'dzum grol nas// bslab gsum lhur len ge sar dgod pa bdag

/mkhas btsun grub rigs 'dzin pa'i 'dren pa khyod// yid gzhung thos bsam bsgom pa'i stobs bdo bas// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan la sman re yi// gang shes mngon dga' brtas pas 'di skad gsol// zhes pa'i mchod brjod dpal ldan daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung gi rgyan las 'phos pa nyung shas kyis mdun bsu nas/ skabs su bab pa'i zhu gsol/ deng 'dir sogs man chad kyi gleng ba snga ma nyid bris pas 'thus so// zhes e waṃ khang gsar du chos skyong bzang por dbul rgyu'i snyan dngags yon tan rin chen 'dren pa'i na dī zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin ched du bod pas bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /rnam lnga'i rigs kyi bde gshegs dga' mar bcas// rgyal sras sems ma bgegs dgra pho mo'i tshogs// kun 'dus bdag nyid 'khor lo'i mgon rnams kyis// rnam kun shis pa'i cho ga sgrubs shig kye// yon tan gzhal du med pas lus can rnams// skad cig mi 'gyur go 'phang bzhag bzod kyang*// dge sdig 'bras bu bslu med rgyal gsung rjes// bsgrub phyir tshogs zung lam nas 'khrid pa rgyal// rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi// gsang gsum che ba'i pha rol ring song ba// 'tshol phyir rgan las thos pa'i 'dren byed stong*// sprul yang ma rnyed gnyid la yur ma gyur// gsung rab yongs kyis brjod bya sdom gsum gyi// bslab bya blang dor ma nor lus can gyi// skal bar 'tsham par so sor ston pa la// shākya'i sras de slar yang lhags sam snyam// skyes sbyangs rtsal gyis sbyangs pa'i mkhyen dpyod mkhar// mtha' klas shes bya'i mi ltung phreng bkra ba'i// khyad par dpyod la gzhung lugs mang thos kyi// ṛ ṣi rnga bong min pa su zhig rtogs// yongs 'du rkang pas 'thung mchog yon tan la// 'dod dgu'i snye mas dud pa'i phrin las bzhis// ris bral mngon 'dod ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams// snod kyi re ba 'gengs la khyod rmad byung*// dkar por byas so kun phan 'od kyis phyogs// rdo thal tshon gyis bkod legs zhal ba'i ngos// mkhas khyod legs mdzad snang bas gangs can ljongs// mkhas btsun bzang po'i mi 'gyur phreng bas kyang*// dpal stug dbang po gnyis pa'i lugs bzang gis// ris bral 'gro la phan pa'i phrin las rgyun// mkhas pa'i bgyi bas skyong bar rgyal kun gyis// re ba'i cod paṇa khyod la bcing ba snyam// brtse bas 'gro bar rjes su chags pa'i tshon// lan mang byugs lta'i bgrod byed dmar ba'i mthil// gzhal bral rdo rjes mtshan pa rnam bkod pa'i// mtha' yas gdul byas bsten pa'i chos kyi khrir// mi dman lhas bskos gyis bskyed dal 'byor rten// bu ram shing sras zhal lung dri med rjes// mngon par bsgrub pa dam bca'i yi ge dag

/chos kyi 'khor lor rnam bkra'i brtul zhugs 'chang*// skye gnyis phal pa'i 'dab ldan rkang 'thung phang*// ca co'i sgra dbyangs thos 'dzin gsos len na// lang tsho rab rgyas gzhan gsos dbyar skyes khrod// kun dga'i glu len 'dzum pas cis mi mnyan// zhes mchod brjod tshogs gsum bstar ba'i dbyangs mchod nyung zad cig sngon du btang nas skabs su bab pa'i zhu gsol/ deng dus ring nas bsags sbyangs phun tshogs dpyid kyi dga' mas nye bar bsu ba'i gsang gsum che ba'i yon tan char ldan dus kyi lang tsho dar la bab mas/ mkhas par 'os pa'i phrin las gsum gyi gru char bsnyil bas/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lugs bzang spyi dang*/ bye brag tu dpal ldan brtse ba chen po'i zhal lung dri med smra ba yongs kyi rgyal po/ 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po kun dga' bzang po pa gang des legs par bzhag pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i dbyar skyes phreng tshogs dkrigs pa'i dga' ston gzhon nu phyogs kyi 'khor lor khyab pa'i dgongs sbyor las nam yang mi g.yel bar brtan par bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ 'di gar 'phyan pa'i dge sbyong gyi na pa'ang gsar 'tshe'i dgun gyi reg bya rnon po lta bus ma bslad par 'tsho ba'i skabs nas bgrang gzhi 'di lor/ mdo khams nor 'dzin ljongs kyi dkyil 'khor la chags pa'i lus can dad mos kyi snying nor bcangs pa'i gson gshin gyi 'gro ba rnams kyi phyogs nas byin pa'i dkor rdzas kyi rigs gtogs nyung shas mchis pa rnams/ yon tan gyi zhing du gyur pa dkon mchog gi phyogs su btang ba'i bsam sbyor gyis kun nas bslangs te mi mngags 'di pa brdzangs pa lags pa nang gshin gyi snyan sgron 'degs pa lags shing*/ da lam bde legs 'byung gzhi bstan pa rin po che ring 'tsho'i cho ga pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyur bcas kyi 'ching ba dgrol ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul phyag sor zlos pa'i gar gyis rtsen pa'i dbang phyug mtshungs zlas dben pa nyid kyi spyan lam du legs gsol maṇ+ḍal brda mtshon du lha dar dkar po sogs/

bcas tshan grangs 'di dag rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa/ ljongs 'dir dbang thang khams mthun gyi ming du na dī e ḍā ra bod pa'i zla ba'i phung po'i zla tshes dge bar/ shākya'i dge sbyong gi brtul zhugs can des/ ma hā bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi thig le/ dpal lhun grub steng gi bla brang phan bde kun khyab gling nas phul ba brtse bzhes dang*/ slad char ngur smrig 'chang sku mdog bzang ri'i rgyal po ltar bskal par brling ba'i thugs bskyed dang rnam dkar phrin las rgyun chags pak+ṣu'i chu rgyun gyi rjes 'gror bsring ba nas/ thugs nyes mdza' ba'i bai ḍūr+ya'i rgyud mangs kyi dbyangs las 'phos pa'i legs bshad nyams 'gyur rgyan gyi phreng bas sgeg pa'ang rim stsol yod pa'i bka' drin yang mi bskyud par mkhyen zhu ba lags so// zhes e waṃ thar rtser 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig gzhan gsos glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /swasti bi dza ya tu/ rab dmar pad+ma rā ga'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la// nyin byed 'od kyis 'khyud pas mtshon min yid srubs thul// tshe mtha' yas pa'i thugs rjes lung rtogs chos kyi bdag /mchog sprul bskal par 'tsho gzhes rab brling dngos grub stsol// rnam 'dren yongs kyi dgongs pa gcig pas mkhyen nus brtse// mtha' dag bsdus pa'i sgyu 'phrul gzugs sku 'gro ba'i gtsug /mdzes byed mchog tu thob pas chu gter bsrubs pa'i zla// dpal mgrin ral par spud de rig byed gtam du bas// dbyangs kyi yan lag rdzogs pa'i rgyud las chos kyi tshul// ji snyed mi 'gyur phreng bar song ba'i rgyan gsum glur// 'dzad med 'jo bas lus can sdug bsngal kun 'byung las// gdon byed smra ba'i nyi ma de ni deng 'dir shar// srid par bltams pa'i sgrib pas ma nongs mkhyen klong du// shes bya'i gzhung lugs grangs tshad dben par grags pa'i dpal// nyung ngur byas dogs skrag pas mgon po khyod thugs la// skyabs su bsten zhes yi ges ga zha 'byin nam snyam// dus gsum gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mnga' dbang thams cad kyi// sna tshogs sems can mos pa'i shing rta phyogs kun nas// gdangs pa snying po de des 'gengs pa'i yon tan yongs// khyed la byin pa min na 'ga' la cang mchis sam// bu ram shing mchog rgyal ba'i mdzad bzang rjes skyong ba'i// mkhas pa'i phrin las 'od srungs byin gyi pha rol tshun// nyul ba'i khor yug chu srin rgyal mtshan bsti ba'i gnas// ma rnyed khong khros kla klo'i grong du 'phyan gyis dogs// bskal mang bsod nams brgya phrag gis bsgrubs mtshan bzang sku// skyes pas rnam brgyan ljongs kyi tha gru yangs pa 'di// skye 'gros phyag 'os nyid du byin gyis brlabs drin che// phrag par theg pa'i gser ldan ma 'di ches cher brling*// bsngags brjod snyan dngags bye bas ngoms min sku yi zhabs// ban+dhu dzī wa ka yi 'dab mar co 'dri mkhan// bskal par 'degs la mi bsnyengs gdong lngas sgeg pa'i khri// lhar bcas skye dgu'i yan lag mchog gis btud pa der// gnam gyi mthongs nas bskos pa'i dbang phyogs gong ma che// rim byon bka' tham gser gyi cod paṇa spyir bcings pa'i// sa skyong rigs kyi skye ba blangs bdag sngon med kyi// rab dka' brtas pa'i tshogs gsum phreng bsgrigs 'di skad gsol// yul mchog tu gyur par mchod brjod dngos po nges bstan gyi snyan dngags yid bzang yul gyi me tog sil mas 'thor bas sngun bsu nas/

skabs su bab pa'i gleng gsol/ deng dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i zlos gar/ skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i rang gzugs/ kun mkhyen bsten pa'i snang byed/ 'gro 'dul sgyu 'phrul rol pa chen po nyid/ mdo khams ljongs kyi thig le'i phyogs 'dir mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i skye ba bzhes par/ sngon gyi smon lam bzang po'i pho nyas/ gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa/ bsod nams stobs su rdzogs pa bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos nye bar mtshon/ 'gro ba rgya mtshos re ba'i phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/ kho bo cag gi yang mes su gyur pa'i sa skyong lu gu rgyud du byon pas legs par bsrungs shing*/ khyad par 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i phrin las gser gyi 'khor los bod khams thams cad dbang gi mnga' bsgyur ba nas brtsams te/ bdag cag spun tshar bcas pas de nyid kyi bstan srid lha gnas kyi grong khyer chen po gong nas gong du 'degs blo dang bya ba mi bskyud pas bskyangs kyin mchis pa'i skabs/ ljongs 'di'i phyogs nas phebs lam mdzad pa'i sku'i 'od zer gyi snang ba dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sku drin gyi phung po'i cha shas gsob pa'i legs gsol 'bul du mi mngags btang ba'i gdong la/ zhu gsol snyan dngags sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal du/ thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi mtho ris bung bas 'bab mtshon du bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po sogs/ tshan 'di dag rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa'i bgrang gzhi sa zla tshes dge bar lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba nas gus par phul ba lags so// zhes khar kha'i rje btsun dam par 'bul tshan gyi gong brjod snyan dngags sin+dhu'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong bla ma'i bkas bskul 'phral du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// sa stag lo'i chu smad kyis nya ba'i mtshan mor zla bar sgra gcan gyis 'jug 'gyur gyi ri mo shar ba'i dge bskul yi ge'i sgra brnyan zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// srid zhi gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i zla nyi dag /bden gnyis rnam dag gdong mjug gis zos pa'i// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ye shes su// snyoms 'jug bla ma dus kyi 'khor lor 'dud// rab byung drug cu'i gnam lo 'dod pa yi// nang gsel 'bru mang ldan pa'i gnam lo zhes// 'od srungs byin gyi dbang thang dgyes rtsen pa'i// sder chags stag gi rgyal pos mnga' bsgyur tshe// gang des ngo mtshar dus kyi dga' ston du// zhag gi phung po chu stod lus phra ma// lang tsho'i dkyil 'khor kun nas rdzogs ma de// snying grogs khab tu khugs pa'i gral tshes bzang*// nyin gyi chu tshod mig mer longs spyad pas// ngoms par ma gyur sngo bsangs mtshan mo'i dus// chu tshod chu bo'i grangs bcas zos pa'i mtshams// mig gsum phyogs nas lhags pa'i sngon gyi lha// sgra gcan mjug ma'i mun grib stug po yis// bdud rtsi'i 'od zer 'byin pa'i dkyil 'khor de// lus pa med par ril por bsgribs pa'i tshon// lcags bsregs zhun ma'i khu bas byugs pa la// le brgan nor bu'i 'od kyis bkab snyam byed// nor lha'i grangs mnyam dbyu gu'i yun tshad la// ga pur rdul dkar 'thor ba'i mthu bral bas// 'dzam gling snod bcud snang ba ma rungs byas// tshad de rdzogs pa'i dbang ldan phyogs cha nas// 'od dkar snang ba phra mo 'byin byed kyin// rim gyis mtshar sdug lang tsho ngom par byed// de skad dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi rol gyi// rtsis gzhung sbyangs pa'i lag rtsis gar ma yis// gaṇ+ḍa'i do ra yangs par gar bsgyur zhing*// 'phrin snyan aṅki'i glu chung blangs pa'o// 'bras bu 'chi med bla mar chu smad kyi// dga' mas bdud rtsi'i dga' ston stobs bgyis pas// blo ldan mkhas dang rgyal po blon bcas dang*// rta dang glang po'i lus stobs nyams 'gyur zhing*// byang phyogs 'dzin mar 'khod rnams nye bar 'tshe// gcig tu rgyu skar 'bras bu lo legs shing*// 'gro ba spyi dang khyad par sa bdag dge

/me tog tshal dang rig byed rnyed pa 'phel// 'di nyin sgo gsum dge ba'i las 'bad dang*// chos spyod rnam bcu bskyed rdzogs bsgom bzlas kyi// phan yon bye ba bdun 'gyur rgyal ba'i bka'// tshad ma'i lung la yid ches brtson par rigs// de skad nyung ngu'i 'phrin bshad dge ba yis// yid can sgrib gsum mun las rnam rgyal nas// yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i bsil zer gyis// phan bde'i sa mos dga' tshal rgyas par shog /ces 'bru mang zhes pa'i gnam lo'i chu smad kyis nya ba'i mtshan mor zla bar sgra gcan gyi dus mes 'jug 'gyur gyi ri mo shar tshe/ dge bskul yi ge dri za'i sgra brnyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gtsug lag smra ba shī la rat+na zhes sam ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder btags pas 'phral du bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// rig pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug 'dod rnams// yi ge'i gru chen ma bzung bar// brgya phrag ngal ba'i rkyal rtsed kyis// don bzang nor bu nam zhig thob// ༈ /yi ge 'bru rkyang 'dri ba'i dper brjod ni// dkar 'jam ngos gzhir pha mdzangs khar nyon la// gzabs gshar yig rigs tha dad kham cha tshad// gug 'greng gna' ru zhabs gcu wa ya btags// ci tsam lobs par bris shig a ho bu// yi ge 'dogs 'brel can gtsor smos dper brjod ni// rim gyis rgya bod yig klog 'dri blo bgrungs// ming gzhi sngon rjes 'jug tshul ming spel tshig /las byed ched 'byung 'brel gzhi bod tshig phrad// dus gsum bskul tshig brda shes drung yig 'gyur// yi ge mgo can gtsor smos dper brjod ni// rten bskrun sman stsal sgra snyan sdeb sbyor rtsis// rtog ge mdo rgyud rnar lhogs bslabs sbyangs sgoms// lkog lce glog ltar rngam brkyangs smra rtsod skyen// sba ljang snyug rtse bsgyur rtsom mkhas par snyegs// yi ge brtsegs 'dogs log sde gtsor smos dper brjod ni// ma hā bho ṭe tiṣ+ṭha paṇ+ḍi ta'i// gran+tha bā dī shī la rat+na yis// bu dhi gsar bus bslab byar bsgrigs pa'i dge

/'gro bas war+ṇaṇa'i de nyid rtogs phyir bsngo// zhes pa 'di'ang slob gsar gyi ngor/ rig pa'i gtsug lag 'dzin pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa'o// //mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od rdul lhung tsam gyis// srid zhi'i dge legs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// gcig car bzhad pa thub mchog nyin mor byed// 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i bsang mchod chu 'dzin spro// 'dir thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug bcas pa'i bsang mchod bya bas/ nyer spyod phye mar shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba spyi ltar byas la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel tshe/ sangs rgyas chos sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ spyan 'dren ni/ hrīḥrang nyid lhar gsal snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od zer pho nya grangs med 'phros pa'i mod// rang bzhin lhun grub gar bzhugs gnas rnams nas// thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas da tshur spyon// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ nam mkhar 'phrog byed brgyad kyis bteg pa'i khrir// chu skyes zla ba bkod legs gdan steng la// ston pa bstan skyong gnas brtan 'khor tshogs bcas// 'gro ba'i don phyir de srid brtan par bzhugs// gsal gdab pa ni/ bsod nams brgya phrag gis bskrun dge mtshan dang*// dpe byad 'bar ba kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen// chos gos gsum mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bcas// bdud 'dul mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag rgyas bzhugs// 'khor du lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin skyong dang*// spel bar gnyer gtad gnas brtan dgra bcom tshogs// mtshams sprin phung po 'char ka'i ma zlum dang*// mnyam par 'grogs ltar ngo mtshar mig gi dpyid// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo bu bzang po pa// gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phreng wa ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// lam brten klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// rang rang 'khor gyi thos sgrogs dgra bcom bcas// kun gyi zhabs 'bring dge bsnyen dharmā tā// thang dzu'i dzung gi rgyal khab 'phags pa'i tshogs// bsod nams shing rtas g.yar 'dren ha shang dang*// chos 'khor bsrung zhing de yi mi mthun phyogs// mthar byed rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas// kun gsal dbang sngon zhun ma'i rtsig logs su// gnam rig tshangs pa'i rdzu 'phrul pir gyi rtses// mthong na mi mthun med pa'i gzugs brnyan 'bum// bkrag cher bris pa'i ltad mo lham mer gsal// bsang mchod spel ba ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum// 'bru gsum rnam par shar ba'i sbyong spel gyis// mchod rdzas bsang rdzas rnam par ye shes kyi// rang snang 'gag med bskal bar 'byung gyur cig /bsang mchod stob pa ni/ ring nas nyer spyad 'dod pa'i yon tan la// bsags bsung nyes skyon 'phags pa rnams la med// gang phyir ci 'dod lhun grub 'jo ba dang*// dag pa'i bdag nyid gtsang byar ci zhig mchis// 'on te bdag sogs bsod nams tshogs bsags dang*// sgo gsum nyes skyon duḥkha sbyang phyir du// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// chu skyes thang skyes 'dab stong bdug pa'i sprin// snang gsal dri chab bshos dang sil snyan dbyangs// dri 'dzin tshim par byed pa'i sman spos dang*// dbyar skyes legs bris rkang 'thung gzhon nu yi// yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ba// mtshun zar bsregs pa'i dri zhim rdzogs ldan sprin// ma dag nyes skyon mthun pa min pa'i phyogs// legs sbyangs gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i dpal// ci yang 'jo bas zhing kun khyab pa 'dis// skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum gyi ngos// lha mi'i ston pa bcom ldan zas gtsang sras// gnas brtan bcu drug dgra bcom zhabs 'bring ba// skal bzang ha shang bka' sdod rgyal chen bcas// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes// bdag cag yon sbyor gyis mtshon sems can gyi// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung nyes skyon rnams// sprin bral mkha' ltar dag pa'i bdag nyid stsol// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ bde legs 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs chos// mkhas tshul gsum gyi snang byed brtse ba che// rgyal tshab kun bzang bcas pa'i ring lugs mchog /phrin las snang bas phyogs mthar 'gengs par shog /sde snod gsum dang gsang chen rgyud kyi don// 'dzin 'chad mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams// 'chad rtsom brtsad pas rgyal bstan nyin mor byed// 'khor ba'i mun 'phrog yun ring brtan par mdzod// bstan pa'i snang byed brtse chen snying po dang*// kun dga' bzang ston dpyad gsum rnam dag gi

/rjes 'jug bshad sgrub lhur len ngur smrig 'chang*// grangs med 'dus pas dbyig 'dzin dog por mdzod// dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur mkhan// sbyin bdag rnams kyi bde dga' rigs rgyud bcas// stobs 'byor tshe ring rdzogs ldan 'khor bsgyur gyi// mnga' thang thams cad de der 'phos snyam mdzod// yul gru 'dis mtshon ljongs 'khod sems can khams// bde skyid lo legs dpal 'byor rgyas pa la// rjes chags dge ba bcu yang de dag gi /sgo gsum la zhugs longs su spyod snyam mdzod// tshul 'dir 'bad med byang chub snying po'i bar// dal ba'i mtsho ldan skyabs gsum zla ba yi// cod paṇa legs 'chang lnga rig rgyan gyis mdzes// chos kun snyan dngags rgyud mangs glur 'jo mdzod// rnam dkar dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nyes pa kun sbyangs nas// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i snying po chos gzugs sku// zung 'jug la gor grub pa nyid gyur cig /phywa g.yang dgug pa ni/ hrīḥ'ajig rten gsum gyi dga' bde dpal 'byor dang*// 'jig rten las 'das mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal// thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus// tshur bsdus sde bzhi'i dpal kun 'phel bar mdzod// bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang*/ ma 'brel na gshegs su gsol ba ni/ thugs rje'i sems can don phyir byon pa'i mgron// yid can mngon 'dod re ba yongs bskangs nas// skye med dbyings su bzhud pa'i tshul ston yang*// smon lam dbang gis ma 'gags skur ston cig /smras pa/ 'dod yon lnga rdzogs mchod pas rab 'byams zhing*// 'gengs pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod par snyeg /dngos grub ci 'dod 'jo bas sngon rabs kyi// mi bdag bsod nams mthu dpal rjes su 'jug /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i rnam dkar dge bas bdag /mchod yul 'phags bzhi mchod pas mnyes byed cing*// sbyin yul 'gro drug sbyin pa rnam bzhi yi// re ba bskang ba'i mgon po nyid gyur cig

/ces thub pa gnas brtan 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad dang gtong ba'i nor can kun dga' rin chen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
